nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if claim logic or dependencies change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Dependency mapping only.

nodes.purpose: Define rules governing the outer boundary of what each source type may support.
nodes.required_output: Support boundary rule register: source type × maximum permissible claim strength × boundary rationale.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, Evidence Ladder; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: boundary rules are explicit per source type; evidence_rationale: boundary rules prevent source overreach; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: boundary rules not formalised. Support: Evidence Ladder and Architecture Governance Rules. Revise: governance rules or evidence ladder changes. Invalidate: rules conflict with Ladder.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not allow a source to support claims beyond its boundary.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if governance rules or Evidence Ladder boundaries change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Boundary rules only.

nodes.purpose: Define the minimum evidence quantity and diversity required for a source-to-claim mapping to be accepted.
nodes.required_output: Mapping evidence requirements table: claim type × minimum source count × required diversity × tier floor.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Evidence Ladder, Architecture Governance Rules; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: requirements are defined per claim type; evidence_rationale: requirements prevent n=1 generalisation; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: mapping requirements not defined. Support: Evidence Ladder minimum-evidence standards. Revise: Ladder or claim type standards change. Invalidate: requirements are unreachable.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat mapping requirement definition as claim validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder or claim domain standards change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Requirements definition only.

nodes.purpose: Define controls to detect and flag BP claims that lack sufficient source support.
nodes.required_output: Unsupported claim control register: detection method, flagging protocol, reviewer role, escalation to BP.12.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture, Architecture Governance Rules; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: controls are explicit and linked to the evidence gap register; evidence_rationale: controls prevent unsupported claims from propagating to narrative; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: unsupported claim controls not defined. Support: audit protocol with claim-support review step. Revise: control process or governance rules change. Invalidate: controls cannot detect unsupported claims.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat absence of detected unsupported claims as claim validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if control process, governance rules, or evidence gap register changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Control definition only.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that the claim-support map is complete, sufficiency-assessed, and gap-documented before downstream use.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: claim inventory, source-to-claim map, sufficiency assessment, gap register, dependency map, boundary rules, requirements, and controls reviewed and coherent.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3.4.1–BP.3.4.8, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all claim-support governance components are present and non-contradictory; evidence_rationale: acceptance verifies claim-support governance; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: claim-support audit not completed. Support: completed architecture review. Revise: any child node changes. Invalidate: claim-support architecture is incoherent.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat claim-support acceptance as claim validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.3.4 child changes or claim wording is revised.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only acceptance.

nodes.purpose: Defines how contradictions, conflicts, and source misuse are identified and routed.
nodes.required_output: Conflict register; source-misuse checklist; BP.12 routing rules.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: source inventory, claim-support map, BP.12 register rules; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture; sufficiency_threshold: conflict and misuse rules exist and route unresolved issues to BP.12; evidence_rationale: contradiction handling is governance infrastructure; cannot_support: resolution of contradictions or claim validation.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no conflict register populated. Support: contradictions logged with affected nodes. Revise: new conflict type appears. Invalidate: conflicts cannot be traced.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not resolve contradictions silently or treat conflict absence as validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new contradiction, source misuse, or unsupported inference is identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.12 owns the uncertainty item; BP.3 only routes it.

nodes.purpose: Identify all detected conflicts or contradictions between sources or between sources and BP claims.
nodes.required_output: Conflict register: conflict ID, sources in conflict, affected BP claim, conflict description, and detection date.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: source inventory, claim-support map; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all detected conflicts are documented; evidence_rationale: conflict identification prevents contradictory evidence from silently supporting claims; cannot_support: conflict resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: conflict register not populated. Support: systematic source cross-review. Revise: new conflicts identified. Invalidate: conflicts cannot be traced.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat conflict documentation as conflict resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new sources, claims, or cross-review reveals conflicts.
nodes.notes_limitations: Identification only.

nodes.purpose: Classify each identified conflict by type and severity.
nodes.required_output: Contradiction classification table: conflict ID × type (factual/methodological/scope/temporal) × severity (minor/moderate/critical) × rationale.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: conflict register, Architecture Governance Rules; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all conflicts are classified with severity; evidence_rationale: classification governs routing and resolution priority; cannot_support: conflict resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: classification not applied. Support: conflict register and governance rules. Revise: classification criteria change. Invalidate: classification cannot be applied.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat classification as resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if classification criteria or conflict register changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Classification only.

nodes.purpose: Define the process for detecting when a source is used to support a claim outside its permitted boundary.
nodes.required_output: Misuse detection protocol: detection method, misuse type taxonomy, reviewer role, and documentation standard.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: source-to-claim map, support boundary rules, Architecture Governance Rules; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: detection protocol is explicit and executable; evidence_rationale: misuse detection protects claim integrity; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: misuse detection protocol not defined. Support: audit checklist with boundary-rule review step. Revise: boundary rules or misuse taxonomy changes. Invalidate: protocol cannot detect misuse.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat absence of detected misuse as validation of correct source use.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if boundary rules, source use, or audit process changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Detection protocol only.

nodes.purpose: Assess the impact of each identified conflict on the BP claims it affects.
nodes.required_output: Severity assessment table: conflict ID × affected claim × impact level (low/medium/high/blocking) × remediation urgency.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: conflict register, claim-support map; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: severity is assessed for each conflict; evidence_rationale: severity assessment determines routing and remediation priority; cannot_support: conflict resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: severity not assessed. Support: conflict register and claim-support map review. Revise: severity criteria change. Invalidate: assessment cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat severity assessment as conflict resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if conflicts, severity criteria, or affected claims change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Severity assessment only.

nodes.purpose: Define the rules for routing identified conflicts to the appropriate resolution domain.
nodes.required_output: Routing rule register: conflict type × severity level × target domain (BP.3/BP.12/controller) × routing action.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, BP.12 risk register; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: routing rules are explicit per conflict type and severity; evidence_rationale: routing rules prevent conflicts from remaining unresolved or misrouted; cannot_support: conflict resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: routing rules not formalised. Support: Architecture Governance Rules applied to conflict taxonomy. Revise: governance rules or conflict taxonomy changes. Invalidate: rules cannot route all conflict types.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat routing completion as conflict resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if governance rules, conflict taxonomy, or BP.12 register changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Routing governance only.

nodes.purpose: Define the specific conditions under which a conflict or source-misuse issue must be escalated to BP.12.
nodes.required_output: BP.12 escalation rule register: trigger condition × conflict/misuse type × escalation action × BP.12 reference.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, BP.12 risk register; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: escalation triggers are explicit and unambiguous; evidence_rationale: escalation rules prevent unresolved conflicts from propagating silently; cannot_support: conflict resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: escalation rules not defined. Support: Architecture Governance Rules and BP.12 protocols. Revise: BP.12 register or escalation criteria change. Invalidate: rules create unresolvable loops.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat BP.12 escalation as conflict resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.12 register or escalation criteria change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Escalation rule definition only.

nodes.purpose: Define the evidence required to resolve or accept a documented conflict.
nodes.required_output: Conflict resolution evidence requirements table: conflict type × required evidence × resolution standard × acceptance condition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, Evidence Ladder; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: resolution evidence requirements are defined per conflict type; evidence_rationale: requirements prevent premature conflict closure; cannot_support: conflict resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: resolution evidence requirements not defined. Support: Architecture Governance Rules and Evidence Ladder. Revise: Ladder or conflict taxonomy changes. Invalidate: requirements cannot be met.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not accept a conflict as resolved without meeting resolution evidence requirements.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder or conflict taxonomy changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Requirements only.

nodes.purpose: Define patterns of conflict resolution that are prohibited regardless of the conflict type.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited resolution pattern register: prohibited pattern × rationale × escalation trigger.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: prohibited patterns are explicit and exhaustive; evidence_rationale: prohibited patterns prevent silent resolution, cherry-picking, and overclaiming; cannot_support: conflict resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibited pattern register not populated. Support: Architecture Governance Rules and conflict governance standards. Revise: new prohibited patterns emerge. Invalidate: prohibitions are contradictory.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not allow any prohibited resolution pattern regardless of conflict severity.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if governance rules or prohibited patterns change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Prohibition governance only.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that conflict identification, classification, routing, and escalation architecture is complete and coherent.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: conflict identification, contradiction classification, misuse detection, severity assessment, routing rules, BP.12 escalation, evidence requirements, and prohibited patterns reviewed and non-contradictory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3.5.1–BP.3.5.8, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all conflict governance components are present and coherent; evidence_rationale: acceptance verifies conflict governance architecture; cannot_support: conflict resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: conflict governance audit not completed. Support: completed architecture review. Revise: any child node changes. Invalidate: conflict governance is incoherent.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat conflict governance acceptance as conflict resolution or claim validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.3.5 child changes or new conflict types emerge.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only acceptance.

nodes.purpose: Determines whether BP.3 is complete enough to govern evidence use.
nodes.required_output: BP.3 acceptance checklist; unresolved gaps; source-use audit.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3 child nodes, architecture audit, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: BP.3.1–BP.3.5 are coherent and free of source-overreach; evidence_rationale: acceptance verifies evidence-governance architecture; cannot_support: claim validation, PMF, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.3 branch audit not completed. Support: completed audit. Revise: missing source rule found. Invalidate: BP.3 cannot prevent source misuse.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat evidence-governance acceptance as evidence sufficiency.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.3 child changes or downstream claims misuse sources.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only acceptance gate.

nodes.purpose: Verify that all required BP.3 child nodes (BP.3.1–BP.3.5) are present and populated.
nodes.required_output: Completeness audit checklist: each BP.3 section × required-output status × population status × gap flag.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3.1–BP.3.5 child nodes; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all BP.3 sections are present with required outputs populated; evidence_rationale: completeness check prevents downstream reliance on empty governance nodes; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: completeness audit not conducted. Support: systematic review of BP.3.1–BP.3.5 against required outputs. Revise: if nodes are empty. Invalidate: required section is absent.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat node presence as node quality.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.3 section is revised or emptied.
nodes.notes_limitations: Completeness check only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.3.1 and BP.3.2 for completeness, consistency, and absence of tier misclassification.
nodes.required_output: Source governance audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3.1–BP.3.2, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: audit is completed with all issues documented; evidence_rationale: source governance audit prevents silent misclassification; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: source governance audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.3.1–BP.3.2. Revise: issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as absence of issues.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.3.1 or BP.3.2 changes or new sources are introduced.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.3.3–BP.3.5 for completeness, mapping accuracy, conflict documentation, and boundary compliance.
nodes.required_output: Evidence governance audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3.3–BP.3.5, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: audit is completed with all issues documented; evidence_rationale: evidence governance audit prevents unsupported claims from propagating; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: evidence governance audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.3.3–BP.3.5. Revise: issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as claim validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.3.3–BP.3.5 changes or claim-support mapping is revised.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Document all evidence gaps identified during the BP.3 governance audit that remain unresolved.
nodes.required_output: Outstanding evidence gap register: gap ID × affected BP.3 node × gap type × BP.12 routing × resolution condition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3 child nodes, BP.12 risk register; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all outstanding gaps are documented with routing; evidence_rationale: gap documentation prevents silent propagation to downstream architecture; cannot_support: gap resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: outstanding gap register not compiled. Support: synthesis of gap registers from BP.3.1–BP.3.5. Revise: gaps are resolved or new gaps emerge. Invalidate: gaps are undocumented.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat gap documentation as gap resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new gaps emerge or existing gap status changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Gap register only.

nodes.purpose: Document all source conflicts identified during the BP.3 governance audit that remain unresolved.
nodes.required_output: Outstanding conflict register: conflict ID × affected claims × severity × resolution status × BP.12 routing.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.3.5 conflict register, BP.12 risk register; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all outstanding conflicts are documented with routing; evidence_rationale: conflict documentation prevents contradictory evidence from silently entering claim support; cannot_support: conflict resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: outstanding conflict register not compiled. Support: synthesis of conflict register from BP.3.5. Revise: conflicts resolved or new conflicts emerge. Invalidate: conflicts are undocumented.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat conflict documentation as conflict resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if conflict status changes or new conflicts are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Conflict register only.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that all BP.12-candidate risks and uncertainties identified across BP.3 have been explicitly routed to the BP.12 risk register.
nodes.required_output: BP.12 routing confirmation log: BP.12-candidate item × source BP.3 node × routing status × BP.12 reference.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3 linked_uncertainties fields, BP.12 risk register; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all BP.12 candidates are confirmed as routed or have an explicit deferral decision; evidence_rationale: routing confirmation ensures risks are not left as orphaned candidates; cannot_support: risk resolution, claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.12 routing not confirmed. Support: systematic review of BP.3 linked_uncertainties. Revise: new BP.12 candidates emerge. Invalidate: candidates are unrouted.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat BP.12 routing as risk resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new BP.12 candidates are identified or routing status changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Routing confirmation only.

nodes.purpose: Record the controller review of BP.3 evidence governance architecture prior to acceptance.
nodes.required_output: Controller review record: reviewer, review date, items reviewed, issues raised, resolution status, and conditional acceptance notes.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3.6.1–BP.3.6.6, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: controller review is documented and issues are resolved or explicitly deferred; evidence_rationale: controller review ensures governance architecture has been independently assessed; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller review not conducted. Support: completed review record. Revise: new issues raised. Invalidate: review cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat controller review as claim validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.3.6 review item changes or new issues are raised.
nodes.notes_limitations: Review record only.

nodes.purpose: Record the formal acceptance decision for BP.3 evidence governance architecture.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance decision record: decision outcome (accepted/conditionally-accepted/deferred/rejected), conditions, date, controller sign-off.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3.6.1–BP.3.6.7, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: acceptance decision is formally recorded with conditions; evidence_rationale: formal acceptance prevents ambiguity about whether BP.3 has been approved for downstream use; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: acceptance decision not recorded. Support: completed controller review with formal decision. Revise: conditions change. Invalidate: decision cannot be made with outstanding blocking issues.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat acceptance as claim validation or evidence sufficiency.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any blocking issue is identified or conditions change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Decision record only.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.3 as a whole is architecturally coherent, gap-documented, and sufficiently governed to support downstream BP architecture.
nodes.required_output: BP.3 branch acceptance checklist: completeness, source governance, evidence governance, outstanding gaps, outstanding conflicts, BP.12 routing, controller review, and acceptance decision all satisfactory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.3.6.1–BP.3.6.8, all BP.3 child nodes, architecture audit, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: BP.3.6.1–BP.3.6.8 are all satisfactory; no open contradiction or unrouted gap remains without controller-approved deferral; evidence_rationale: branch acceptance gate verifies BP.3 is coherent enough to constrain downstream architecture; cannot_support: claim validity, demand, PMF, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: branch audit not completed. Support: all BP.3.6 checks satisfactory. Revise: child nodes conflict. Invalidate: open contradictions remain without deferral.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat BP.3 branch acceptance as evidence sufficiency or claim validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.3 child changes, new conflicts emerge, or downstream architecture misuses sources.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only branch acceptance gate.

nodes.node_title: Market Boundaries, Sizing, Segmentation, and ICP
nodes.purpose: Governs market boundary, sizing logic, segmentation, prioritisation, ICP, beachhead, and segment exclusions.
nodes.required_output: BP.4 Level 2 node set covering market boundary, TAM/SAM/SOM logic, segmentation, ICP/beachhead definition, exclusions, and market-architecture acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.1 scope, BP.3-governed market sources, segmentation evidence, buyer/discovery evidence where applicable; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E3+ for external market facts, E4+ for user segment evidence, E6+ for institutional segment evidence; sufficiency_threshold: BP.4 defines market architecture and evidence requirements without asserting validated market size or demand; evidence_rationale: market architecture must separate boundaries, models, assumptions, and validated evidence; cannot_support: demand, adoption, WTP, procurement readiness, PMF, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: market data, sizing inputs, segment evidence, and ICP validation are not populated. Support: sourced market model and governed segment evidence. Revise: category, geography, ICP, or segment evidence changes. Invalidate: market boundary contradicts BP.1 scope or sizing relies on unsupported assumptions.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — market-boundary uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — sizing-assumption risk; BP.12 candidate — ICP-validation gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not present TAM/SAM/SOM as validated demand, revenue, market traction, PMF, or investor-ready proof. Must not infer buyer willingness or procurement readiness from segment size.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product scope, geography, category, evidence source, segment logic, or ICP assumptions change.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.4 defines market architecture only; market research and validation remain evidence-dependent.

nodes.purpose: Defines the market boundary before sizing or segmentation.
nodes.required_output: Market boundary statement; inclusion/exclusion rules; geography/category links.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.1 scope, BP.3 source rules, market-boundary sources; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E3+ for external market facts; sufficiency_threshold: market boundary is explicit and not treated as validated demand; evidence_rationale: boundary definition constrains later sizing; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: market boundary evidence not populated. Support: sourced boundary evidence. Revise: category/geography changes. Invalidate: boundary conflicts with BP.1.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer market size or demand from boundary definition.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if category, geography, or segment scope changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Boundary precedes sizing.

nodes.purpose: State the governed market definition in one bounded sentence.
nodes.required_output: One-sentence market definition statement identifying the category, served geography, and relevant actor without implying validation or demand.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because the node defines the governed market boundary for planning and downstream architecture, not whether the market is validated, attractive, or demand-bearing.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller-approved market definition wording not attached.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — market definition overclaim risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim market definition proves demand, PMF, or market size.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product scope, category, or geography changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture definition only; does not establish market reality.

nodes.purpose: Define which buyers, use cases, and segments are within the governed market boundary.
nodes.required_output: Inclusion register: buyer type, use case, segment, and inclusion rationale.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because included scope determines which buyers, use cases, and segments may be governed by BP.4, while preventing inclusion from being treated as evidence of demand or market fit.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: inclusion register not formalised. Support: accepted product scope and category boundary. Revise: if product scope or category changes.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer demand or market size from inclusion definition.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product scope or category changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Inclusion defines architecture scope, not market validation.

nodes.purpose: Define which buyers, use cases, and segments are explicitly outside the governed market boundary.
nodes.required_output: Exclusion register: excluded type, exclusion rationale, review trigger.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because excluded scope prevents uncontrolled market expansion and clarifies what BP.4 does not govern, without implying absence of demand or opportunity.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: exclusion register not formalised.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim excluded segments lack demand or opportunity.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product scope, strategy, or non-scope changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Exclusions are scope governance, not market quality judgement.

nodes.purpose: Define the product category boundary relevant to market sizing and segmentation.
nodes.required_output: Category boundary statement linked to BP.1.5 category hypothesis.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because category boundaries govern which market-sizing and segmentation logic may be used, without proving category existence, growth, or demand.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: category boundary not linked to BP.1.5. Support: BP.1.5 category architecture acceptance.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer market size or demand from category boundary.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.1.5 category architecture changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Routes to BP.1.5 for category governance.

nodes.purpose: Define the geographic scope governing this market architecture.
nodes.required_output: Geographic boundary statement linked to BP.1.6 geographic scope.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because geography defines the planning boundary for market architecture and downstream compliance/deployability review, without proving market attractiveness or deployability.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: geographic boundary not linked to BP.1.6.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer market attractiveness or demand from geographic boundary.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.1.6 geographic scope changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Routes to BP.1.6 for geographic governance.

nodes.purpose: State all unvalidated assumptions underpinning the market boundary definition.
nodes.required_output: Boundary assumption register with falsification conditions.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because boundary assumptions must be explicit and falsifiable before market architecture can be reviewed, but assumption documentation does not validate the boundary.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: assumption register not formalised.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat assumption completeness as boundary validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if boundary assumptions are contradicted by market evidence.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption governance only.

nodes.purpose: Define evidence type, tier, and sufficiency threshold required before strengthening market boundary claims.
nodes.required_output: Boundary evidence requirements matrix: evidence tier per boundary claim, permitted sources, sufficiency thresholds.
nodes.evidence_requirement: Evidence Ladder and BP.3 source-governance evidence are required because this node defines future evidence standards for market-boundary claims, not whether those claims are already validated.

nodes.evidence_requirement: Evidence Ladder and BP.3 evidence are required because this node defines what would justify strengthening, maintaining, or reversing exclusion decisions, not whether exclusions are final or market-validated.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: evidence requirements not defined.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — exclusion evidence requirement gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat evidence requirements as exclusion evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Defines proof burden only.

nodes.purpose: Define all conclusions that segment exclusion decisions must never support.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited inference register for segment exclusions.
nodes.evidence_requirement: governance-rule evidence is required because this node prevents exclusions from being misused as proof of competitive superiority, demand absence, or market proof.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — prohibited exclusion inference completeness
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer competitive superiority, demand absence, or market validation from segment exclusion decisions.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new prohibited patterns emerge.
nodes.notes_limitations: Prohibitions are absolute.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.4.5 is internally coherent, complete, and free of prohibited inferences.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: excluded segment inventory, exclusion criteria, justification, temporary/permanent classification, assumptions, evidence requirements, and prohibited inferences present and coherent.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed child nodes and architecture audit are required because this node accepts BP.4.5 as coherent exclusion architecture only, not as proof of demand absence, competitive superiority, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller approval not recorded.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — segment exclusion acceptance gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat exclusion acceptance as market validation or competitive proof.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.4.5 child changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architectural acceptance only.

nodes.purpose: Determines whether BP.4 is coherent enough for downstream buyer, GTM, and validation design.
nodes.required_output: BP.4 acceptance checklist; unresolved assumptions; BP.12 links.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.4 child nodes, BP.3 evidence governance, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture; higher tiers by claim type; sufficiency_threshold: boundary, sizing logic, segmentation, ICP, and exclusions are coherent and claim-limited; evidence_rationale: acceptance checks architecture only; cannot_support: demand, WTP, PMF, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.4 audit not complete. Support: completed architecture audit. Revise: child node conflict. Invalidate: BP.4 uses unsupported claims.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat market architecture as market validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.1 scope, evidence, or segment priorities change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture gate only.

nodes.purpose: Verify that all required BP.4 child sections (BP.4.1–BP.4.5) are present and populated.
nodes.required_output: Completeness audit checklist: each BP.4 section × required-output status × population status × gap flag.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.4 child sections are required because this node verifies presence and population of market-architecture components, not their substantive validity or market evidence sufficiency.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: completeness audit not conducted.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat node presence as node quality or market validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.4 section is revised or emptied.
nodes.notes_limitations: Completeness check only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.4.1 for internal coherence, completeness, and absence of prohibited inferences.
nodes.required_output: BP.4.1 audit report: completeness status, contradiction status, prohibited claims status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.4.1 evidence is required because this node audits market-boundary coherence and claim discipline, not market validation or demand.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.4.1 audit not conducted.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as market boundary validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.4.1 changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.4.2 for internal coherence, completeness, and absence of prohibited inferences.
nodes.required_output: BP.4.2 audit report: completeness status, contradiction status, prohibited claims status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.4.2 evidence is required because this node audits sizing-model coherence and prohibited-inference control, not demand, revenue, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.4.2 audit not conducted.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as market sizing validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.4.2 changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.4.3 for internal coherence, completeness, and absence of prohibited inferences.
nodes.required_output: BP.4.3 audit report: completeness status, contradiction status, prohibited claims status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.4.3 evidence is required because this node audits segment-architecture coherence and claim discipline, not demand, adoption, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.4.3 audit not conducted.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as segment demand validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.4.3 changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.4.4 for internal coherence, completeness, and absence of prohibited inferences.
nodes.required_output: BP.4.4 audit report: completeness status, contradiction status, prohibited claims status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.4.4 evidence is required because this node audits ICP and beachhead architecture coherence, not ICP demand, adoption, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.4.4 audit not conducted.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as ICP validation or buyer confirmation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.4.4 changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit only.

nodes.purpose: Document all outstanding market assumptions across BP.4 that have not been resolved.
nodes.required_output: Outstanding assumption register: assumption, source BP.4 node, gap type, resolution condition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.4 assumption nodes are required because this node records unresolved market assumptions across the branch, without resolving those assumptions or validating the market.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: outstanding assumption register not consolidated.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — BP.4 outstanding assumption risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat assumption documentation as assumption resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new assumptions are identified or existing ones change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Register only; resolution routes to evidence collection.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that all BP.12-candidate risks and uncertainties across BP.4 have been routed to the BP.12 register.
nodes.required_output: BP.12 routing confirmation log: BP.12-candidate item, source BP.4 node, routing status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: linked_uncertainties fields and BP.12 register evidence are required because this node verifies uncertainty routing, not risk resolution or market validation.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.12 routing not confirmed.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — BP.4 BP.12 routing completeness
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat BP.12 routing as risk resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new BP.12 candidates are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Routing confirmation only.

nodes.purpose: Record the controller review and acceptance decision for BP.4 market architecture.
nodes.required_output: Controller acceptance decision record: review scope, open contradictions, controller decision, conditions, and reopen triggers.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed audit nodes and controller review are required because this node records an architecture acceptance decision, not market validation, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller review not recorded.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — BP.4 controller review gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat controller acceptance as market validation or commercial readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.4 section changes after acceptance.
nodes.notes_limitations: Governance record only.

nodes.purpose: Determine whether BP.4 as a whole is architecturally coherent, gap-documented, and sufficiently governed to support downstream BP architecture.
nodes.required_output: BP.4 branch acceptance checklist: completeness audit, boundary audit, sizing audit, segment audit, ICP audit, outstanding assumptions, BP.12 routing, controller decision all satisfactory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.4 child nodes, audit evidence, and controller review are required because this node determines branch-level architecture coherence only, not validated market, revenue, procurement readiness, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no completed BP.4 branch audit.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — BP.4 architecture acceptance risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat BP.4 architecture acceptance as market validation, demand evidence, sizing proof, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.4 child changes, market evidence contradicts architecture, or BP.6 discovery requires revision.
nodes.notes_limitations: Acceptance is architecture-only; does not validate market, demand, PMF, or investor readiness.

nodes.node_title: Users, Buyers, Procurement, and Buying System
nodes.purpose: Governs user, buyer, economic decision-maker, procurement, influencer, blocker, approver, stakeholder power, and budget-cycle architecture.
nodes.required_output: BP.5 Level 2 node set covering role map, buying centre, budget authority, procurement path, budget cycle, and buying-system acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.4 ICP, user interviews, buyer interviews, procurement evidence, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E4+ for user-role evidence, E5+ for buyer/procurement evidence, E6+ for institutional buying-system evidence; sufficiency_threshold: BP.5 separates user, buyer, authority, procurement, and timing claims without validating purchase readiness; evidence_rationale: buying systems require distinct evidence for role, authority, approval path, and timing; cannot_support: demand, WTP, procurement readiness, PMF, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: buyer roles, budget authority, procurement path, and budget-cycle evidence are not populated. Support: buyer/procurement discovery and institutional process evidence. Revise: roles, authority, or procurement path change. Invalidate: no credible buying path can be identified.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — buyer-role uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — budget-authority assumption; BP.12 candidate — procurement-path uncertainty
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer buyer authority from user pain, interest, title seniority, or stakeholder enthusiasm. Must not infer procurement readiness from a mapped buying process.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ICP, buyer roles, budget authority, procurement path, approval process, or budget cycle changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.5 maps buying architecture; it does not establish procurement readiness or willingness to pay.

nodes.purpose: Defines and separates user, buyer, influencer, blocker, approver, and decision-maker roles within the buying architecture.
nodes.required_output: Role map; stakeholder-type register; role separation checklist; evidence requirements; role-architecture acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: user interviews, buyer interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E4+ for user-role evidence, E5+ for buyer/decision-maker evidence; sufficiency_threshold: roles are distinct, non-conflated, and not inferred from pain or enthusiasm; evidence_rationale: role separation prevents audience conflation and demand overclaiming; cannot_support: purchase intent, procurement readiness, WTP, PMF, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: role evidence not populated. Support: coded user/buyer interviews per role type. Revise: role boundaries shift through discovery. Invalidate: roles cannot be distinguished within target institution.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — buyer-role uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — role-conflation risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not conflate user pain with buyer motivation or infer decision authority from stakeholder enthusiasm.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ICP changes, discovery reveals different role assignments, or buyer/user distinction is contradicted.
nodes.notes_limitations: Role separation governs downstream authority and procurement claims.

nodes.purpose: Define the end user in one bounded statement without implying buyer authority or purchase intent.
nodes.required_output: End user definition: actor, workflow context, usage relationship, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: user interviews, canonical_product_context; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E4+ for user-confirmed role evidence; sufficiency_threshold: end user is defined separately from buyer, approver, or decision-maker; cannot_support: purchase intent, WTP, procurement readiness, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: user-definition evidence not attached. Support: coded user interviews confirming role. Revise: if discovery reveals different primary users. Invalidate: user cannot be distinguished from buyer.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer purchase intent, WTP, or buyer authority from user role definition.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ICP or primary user definition changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: User definition only; does not establish buyer role or purchase authority.

nodes.purpose: Define the buyer in one bounded statement, distinguishing buyer from user and from economic decision-maker.
nodes.required_output: Buyer definition: actor, authority scope, distinction from user and decision-maker, evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: buyer interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E5+ for buyer-confirmed role evidence; sufficiency_threshold: buyer is explicitly distinguished from user and from budget authority; cannot_support: WTP, purchase intent, procurement readiness, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: buyer-role evidence not populated. Support: buyer discovery interviews. Revise: if discovery shows buyer and user are the same actor. Invalidate: no distinct buyer role can be identified.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer budget authority from buyer role. Must not conflate buyer with user.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if buyer identity or role scope changes through discovery.
nodes.notes_limitations: Buyer definition only; authority and procurement path governed separately.

nodes.purpose: Define the influencer role: actor who shapes but does not make the buying decision.
nodes.required_output: Influencer definition: actor type, influence mechanism, scope of influence, evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: buyer interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E4+ for stakeholder-confirmed influence evidence; sufficiency_threshold: influencer is distinguished from buyer, approver, and decision-maker without conflating influence with authority; cannot_support: purchase intent, procurement readiness, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: influencer evidence not populated. Support: buyer/stakeholder interviews. Revise: if influence patterns differ. Invalidate: no distinct influencer role can be identified.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat influencer approval as procurement authority or purchase intent.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if stakeholder influence patterns change through discovery.
nodes.notes_limitations: Influence does not equal authority; governance routes to BP.5.2.

nodes.purpose: Define the blocker role: actor who can prevent or delay a buying decision without having purchase authority.
nodes.required_output: Blocker definition: actor type, blocking mechanism, blocking conditions, evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: buyer interviews, procurement interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E5+ for blocker-confirmed evidence; sufficiency_threshold: blocker is defined with explicit mechanism and cannot be used to infer procurement readiness; cannot_support: WTP, procurement readiness, PMF, or commercial feasibility.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: blocker evidence not populated. Support: procurement/buyer interviews. Revise: if blocking roles differ by institution type. Invalidate: no blocking actor can be identified.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer GTM readiness from absence of known blockers.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if institutional blockers change or new blocking roles are discovered.
nodes.notes_limitations: Blocker identification governs procurement-path risk; routes to BP.5.4.

nodes.purpose: Define the approver role: actor whose formal sign-off is required before a purchase can proceed.
nodes.required_output: Approver definition: actor type, approval scope, approval sequence position, evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: procurement interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E5/E6 for approver-confirmed evidence; sufficiency_threshold: approver is distinguished from decision-maker and defined with explicit approval scope; cannot_support: procurement readiness, purchase intent, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: approver evidence not populated. Support: procurement process interviews. Revise: if approval requirements differ by institution type. Invalidate: no identifiable approver exists.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat mapped approver as evidence of procurement readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if institutional approval requirements or processes change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Approver definition routes to BP.5.4 procurement path.

nodes.purpose: Define the decision-maker role: actor with final authority to commit to a purchase.
nodes.required_output: Decision-maker definition: actor type, authority scope, decision criteria, evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: buyer interviews, procurement interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E5/E6 for decision-maker-confirmed authority evidence; sufficiency_threshold: decision-maker is explicitly identified and distinguished from approver and budget-holder without implying purchase intent; cannot_support: WTP, procurement readiness, PMF, or commercial certainty.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: decision-maker evidence not populated. Support: procurement/institutional interviews. Revise: if decision authority rests at different level. Invalidate: no identifiable decision-maker can be traced.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer purchase intent or WTP from decision-maker identification.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if decision authority, organisational structure, or procurement policy changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Decision-maker authority does not imply willingness to pay.

nodes.purpose: Define the evidence type, tier, source family, and sufficiency threshold required before strengthening any user or buyer role claim.
nodes.required_output: Role evidence requirements matrix: evidence tier per role type, permitted source families, sufficiency thresholds, escalation routes.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Evidence Ladder, Architecture Governance Rules, BP.3 source governance; evidence_tier_required: E1 for requirements architecture; sufficiency_threshold: each role type has documented evidence tier and source family; cannot_support: role validation, purchase intent, procurement readiness, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: role evidence requirements matrix not defined. Support: Evidence Ladder applied to each role claim type. Revise: if Ladder thresholds change. Invalidate: requirements conflict with BP.3.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat evidence requirements as role validation. Must not infer purchase readiness from role evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder or BP.3 governance changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Defines proof burden only; does not provide role evidence.

nodes.purpose: Define all conclusions that buyer and user role evidence must never support, regardless of evidence quantity.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited role inference register: prohibited conclusion, role component protected, escalation trigger if violated.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, BP.3 source governance; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all prohibited role inferences are explicitly documented and exhaustive; cannot_support: WTP, purchase intent, procurement readiness, PMF, or commercial certainty from role evidence alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated. Support: completed prohibition matrix. Revise: if new prohibited patterns emerge. Invalidate: prohibitions are internally contradictory.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not allow role evidence to support purchase intent, WTP, procurement authority, or PMF claims.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new prohibited inference patterns emerge or downstream narrative implies prohibited role claims.
nodes.notes_limitations: Prohibitions are absolute; role mapping does not establish purchase readiness.

nodes.node_title: User and Buyer Role Acceptance Check
nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.5.1 is internally coherent, complete, and free of prohibited role inferences before buying-centre architecture proceeds.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: user, buyer, influencer, blocker, approver, decision-maker definitions, evidence requirements, and prohibited inferences present, coherent, and non-contradictory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.5.1.1–BP.5.1.8, architecture audit, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: BP.5.1.1–BP.5.1.8 are complete, coherent, and free of prohibited inferences; cannot_support: purchase intent, procurement readiness, WTP, PMF, or commercial certainty.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller approval not recorded. Support: completed architecture review. Revise: if any BP.5.1 child changes. Invalidate: if contradictions remain.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat role-architecture acceptance as buyer validation or procurement readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.5.1 child changes or discovery contradicts role architecture.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only gate.

nodes.purpose: Defines buying-centre composition and stakeholder influence without implying procurement authority or purchase intent.
nodes.required_output: Buying-centre map; power/influence matrix; blocker map; evidence requirements; buying-centre acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: buyer interviews, procurement evidence, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E4+ for stakeholder evidence, E6+ for institutional buying-centre evidence; sufficiency_threshold: influence claims are role-specific and evidence-backed; cannot_support: purchase intent, procurement readiness, PMF, or revenue.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: stakeholder power not evidenced. Support: buyer/procurement interviews. Revise: if stakeholder influence differs. Invalidate: assumed buying centre absent.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer buying-centre power from org chart alone.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if buying actors or influence patterns change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Power map is a hypothesis until evidenced.

nodes.purpose: Define who participates in the buying decision and in what capacity within the target institution type.
nodes.required_output: Buying-centre composition register: actor type, role in buying process, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: buyer interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E4+ for stakeholder-confirmed composition evidence, E6+ for institutional buying-centre evidence; sufficiency_threshold: composition is actor-specific, non-overlapping, and not inferred from org charts alone; cannot_support: purchase intent, WTP, procurement readiness, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: buying-centre composition not evidenced. Support: coded buyer and procurement interviews. Revise: if composition differs by institution size or type. Invalidate: no buying centre can be identified.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer composition from org chart alone or treat composition as purchase readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if target institution type changes or composition evidence is contradicted.
nodes.notes_limitations: Composition mapping only; does not establish purchase intent.

nodes.purpose: Identify all stakeholders who interact with or are affected by the product within the buying institution.
nodes.required_output: Stakeholder identification register: stakeholder type, relationship to product, relationship to buying decision, and evidence required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: buyer interviews, user interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E4+ for stakeholder confirmation; sufficiency_threshold: all relevant stakeholder types are identified and non-conflated; cannot_support: purchase intent, WTP, procurement authority, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: stakeholder identification not completed. Support: coded interviews across stakeholder types. Revise: if new stakeholder types emerge through discovery. Invalidate: if key stakeholders are systematically absent.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer purchase intent from stakeholder interest or engagement.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if institution type, product scope, or discovery reveals missing stakeholders.
nodes.notes_limitations: Identification only; influence and authority governed separately.

nodes.purpose: Map the direction and magnitude of influence each stakeholder type exerts on the buying decision without inferring authority.
nodes.required_output: Influence matrix: stakeholder type × influence direction × influence magnitude × evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: buyer interviews, procurement interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E4+ for influence-confirmed evidence; sufficiency_threshold: influence is mapped by stakeholder type without conflating influence with authority or purchase intent; cannot_support: purchase authority, WTP, procurement readiness, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: influence mapping not evidenced. Support: coded buyer and procurement interviews with explicit influence signals. Revise: if influence patterns differ by institution. Invalidate: influence cannot be traced to specific stakeholder types.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer decision authority from stakeholder influence. Must not treat high influence as purchase intent.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if influence patterns change or institution type shifts.
nodes.notes_limitations: Influence mapping only; authority governed in BP.5.3.

nodes.purpose: Map formal and informal authority relationships between stakeholders in the buying decision without implying procurement readiness.
nodes.required_output: Authority relationship map: stakeholder type × authority type × relationship to other stakeholders × evidence required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: procurement interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E5/E6 for authority relationship evidence; sufficiency_threshold: authority relationships are explicitly evidenced and not inferred from title seniority alone; cannot_support: purchase intent, WTP, procurement readiness, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: authority relationship evidence not populated. Support: procurement and institutional interviews. Revise: if authority structures differ by institution size. Invalidate: authority relationships cannot be mapped.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer authority from seniority or enthusiasm. Must not treat mapped authority as procurement readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if organisational structures or authority patterns change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Authority relationships inform procurement path; procurement-path governance is in BP.5.4.

nodes.purpose: Identify which stakeholders function as champions (accelerate purchase) and blockers (impede purchase) within the buying centre.
nodes.required_output: Champion-blocker register: stakeholder type, role (champion/neutral/blocker), mechanism, evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: buyer interviews, procurement interviews; evidence_tier_required: E4+ for champion/blocker confirmation; sufficiency_threshold: champions and blockers are identified by stakeholder type and mechanism without treating champion presence as purchase intent; cannot_support: WTP, purchase intent, procurement readiness, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: champion-blocker evidence not populated. Support: coded interviews with explicit champion/blocker signals. Revise: if roles shift by institution or deal stage. Invalidate: no champion or blocker patterns can be identified.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer purchase intent from champion enthusiasm. Must not treat blocker absence as procurement readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if stakeholder dynamics change or new champion/blocker types emerge.
nodes.notes_limitations: Champion presence does not imply purchase readiness; routes to BP.5.4.

nodes.purpose: State all unvalidated assumptions underpinning the buying-centre architecture with explicit falsification conditions.
nodes.required_output: Buying-centre assumption register: assumption, component supported, labelled unvalidated, falsification condition, support/revise/invalidate triggers.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal architecture, founder hypothesis, assumption ledger; evidence_tier_required: E1 for candidate assumptions; sufficiency_threshold: all buying-centre assumptions are explicit, labelled as unvalidated, and falsifiable; cannot_support: buying-centre validity, purchase intent, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: assumption register not formalised. Support: completed assumption ledger with falsification conditions. Revise: if discovery validates or contradicts assumptions. Invalidate: assumptions are unstated or non-falsifiable.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat assumption completeness as buying-centre validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if discovery validates, revises, or invalidates any buying-centre assumption.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption governance only; does not substitute for discovery evidence.

nodes.purpose: Define evidence type, tier, source family, and sufficiency threshold required before strengthening buying-centre claims.
nodes.required_output: Buying-centre evidence requirements matrix: evidence tier per buying-centre claim, permitted sources, sufficiency thresholds.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Evidence Ladder, Architecture Governance Rules, BP.3 source governance; evidence_tier_required: E1 for requirements architecture; sufficiency_threshold: each buying-centre claim type has documented evidence tier and source family; cannot_support: buying-centre validation, purchase intent, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: evidence requirements matrix not defined. Support: Evidence Ladder applied per buying-centre claim. Revise: if Ladder thresholds change. Invalidate: requirements conflict with BP.3.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — buying-centre evidence requirement gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat evidence requirements as buying-centre validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder or BP.3 governance changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Defines proof burden only.

nodes.purpose: Define all conclusions that buying-centre evidence must never support, regardless of evidence quantity.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited buying-centre inference register: prohibited conclusion, protected component, escalation trigger.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, BP.3 source governance; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all prohibited buying-centre inferences explicitly documented; cannot_support: purchase intent, WTP, procurement readiness, PMF, or commercial certainty from buying-centre evidence alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated. Support: completed prohibition matrix. Revise: if new prohibited patterns emerge. Invalidate: prohibitions are contradictory.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not allow buying-centre evidence to support procurement readiness, WTP, or PMF claims.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new prohibited patterns emerge or narrative implies prohibited inferences.
