nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: completeness audit not conducted. Support: systematic review of BP.5.1–BP.5.5 against required outputs. Revise: if nodes are empty. Invalidate: if required sections are absent.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat node presence as node quality.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.5 section is revised or emptied.
nodes.notes_limitations: Completeness check only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.5.1 for completeness, coherence, and absence of prohibited role inferences.
nodes.required_output: Role map audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.5.1 child nodes, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: role map audit is completed with all issues documented; cannot_support: role validation, purchase intent, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: role map audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.5.1.1–BP.5.1.9. Revise: if issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as absence of issues.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.5.1 changes or new role-map issues are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.5.2 for completeness, composition coherence, and absence of prohibited buying-centre inferences.
nodes.required_output: Buying centre audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.5.2 child nodes, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: buying centre audit is completed with all issues documented; cannot_support: buying-centre validation, purchase intent, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: buying centre audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.5.2.1–BP.5.2.9. Revise: if issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as buying-centre validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.5.2 changes or new buying-centre issues are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.5.3 for completeness, authority coherence, and absence of prohibited budget authority inferences.
nodes.required_output: Budget authority audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.5.3 child nodes, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: budget authority audit is completed with all issues documented; cannot_support: authority validation, WTP, purchase intent, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: budget authority audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.5.3.1–BP.5.3.9. Revise: if issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as budget authority validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.5.3 changes or new authority issues are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.5.4 and BP.5.5 for completeness, process coherence, and absence of prohibited procurement and timing inferences.
nodes.required_output: Procurement and timing audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.5.4–BP.5.5 child nodes, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: procurement and timing audit is completed with all issues documented; cannot_support: procurement readiness, WTP, purchase intent, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: procurement and timing audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.5.4.1–BP.5.5.9. Revise: if issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as procurement readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.5.4 or BP.5.5 changes or new procurement/timing issues are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Document all known unvalidated assumptions across BP.5 that remain open, with routing to BP.12.
nodes.required_output: Outstanding assumption register: assumption, affected BP.5 node, assumption type, BP.12 routing, resolution condition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.5.x assumption registers, BP.12 risk register; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all outstanding assumptions documented with BP.12 routing and resolution conditions; cannot_support: assumption resolution, procurement readiness, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: outstanding assumption register not compiled. Support: synthesis of assumption registers from BP.5.1–BP.5.5. Revise: if assumptions are resolved or new ones emerge. Invalidate: assumptions are left undocumented.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat assumption documentation as assumption resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new assumptions are identified or existing assumption status changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption register only; does not resolve outstanding assumptions.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that all BP.12-candidate risks and uncertainties identified across BP.5 have been explicitly routed to the BP.12 risk register.
nodes.required_output: BP.12 routing confirmation log: BP.12-candidate item × source BP.5 node × routing status × BP.12 reference.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.5 linked_uncertainties fields, BP.12 risk register; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all BP.12 candidates are confirmed as routed or have an explicit deferral decision; cannot_support: risk resolution, procurement readiness, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.12 routing not confirmed. Support: systematic review of BP.5 linked_uncertainties. Revise: if new BP.12 candidates emerge. Invalidate: candidates are unrouted.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat BP.12 routing as risk resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new BP.12 candidates are identified or routing status changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Routing confirmation only.

nodes.purpose: Record the controller review and formal acceptance decision for BP.5 buying-system architecture.
nodes.required_output: Controller review record and acceptance decision: reviewer, review date, items reviewed, issues raised, decision outcome, conditions, and controller sign-off.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.5.6.1–BP.5.6.7, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: controller review is documented and acceptance decision is formally recorded with conditions; cannot_support: procurement readiness, WTP, purchase intent, PMF, or commercial certainty.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller review not conducted. Support: completed review record with formal decision. Revise: if conditions change. Invalidate: blocking issues remain unresolved without deferral.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat controller review as claim validation or procurement readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.5.6 review item changes or new blocking issues are raised.
nodes.notes_limitations: Review and decision record only.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.5 as a whole is architecturally coherent, gap-documented, and sufficiently governed to support downstream GTM and validation planning.
nodes.required_output: BP.5 branch acceptance checklist: completeness, role map audit, buying centre audit, budget authority audit, procurement audit, outstanding assumptions, BP.12 routing, controller review, and acceptance decision all satisfactory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.5.6.1–BP.5.6.8, all BP.5 child nodes, architecture audit, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: BP.5.6.1–BP.5.6.8 are all satisfactory; no open contradiction, unrouted gap, or prohibited claim violation remains without controller-approved deferral; cannot_support: procurement readiness, PMF, WTP, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: branch audit not completed. Support: all BP.5.6 checks satisfactory. Revise: child nodes conflict. Invalidate: open contradictions remain without deferral.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat BP.5 branch acceptance as buyer validation, procurement readiness, or commercial certainty.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.5 child changes, discovery contradicts buying-system architecture, or downstream GTM planning requires architectural revision.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only branch acceptance gate.

nodes.node_title: Customer Discovery, Adoption, and Institutional Legitimacy
nodes.purpose: Governs discovery, JTBD, alternatives, pain intensity, adoption barriers, WTP signals, institutional legitimacy, trust friction, and adoption sequencing.
nodes.required_output: BP.6 Level 2 node set covering discovery protocol, current alternatives, pain/barriers, WTP signals, trust/legitimacy, adoption sequencing, and discovery/adoption acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: discovery interviews, workflow evidence, buyer evidence, institutional evidence, BP.3-governed sources; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture, E4+ for user discovery, E5+ for buyer/WTP signals, E6+ for institutional adoption constraints; sufficiency_threshold: BP.6 defines discovery and adoption-evidence architecture without claiming adoption, WTP, or PMF; evidence_rationale: discovery must separate pain, interest, behaviour, value perception, institutional constraints, and validated adoption; cannot_support: demand, WTP, procurement readiness, PMF, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: discovery protocol, interviews, adoption evidence, WTP signals, and trust evidence are not populated. Support: coded discovery, behavioural, buyer, or institutional evidence. Revise: user jobs, alternatives, pain, barriers, or trust constraints change. Invalidate: discovery evidence contradicts the target problem or adoption logic.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — discovery-evidence gap; BP.12 candidate — adoption-overclaim risk; BP.12 candidate — WTP-signal uncertainty
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer demand from pain, adoption from interest, WTP from compliments, procurement readiness from enthusiasm, or PMF from discovery.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ICP, buyer roles, discovery evidence, alternatives, adoption barriers, WTP signals, or validation design changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.6 designs and governs discovery/adoption evidence; BP.10 owns validation and learning logic.

nodes.purpose: Defines what discovery must test about jobs, context, and current behaviour.
nodes.required_output: Discovery protocol; JTBD coding rules; evidence thresholds.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: discovery interviews, workflow evidence; evidence_tier_required: E4+ for user evidence, E6+ for institutional evidence; sufficiency_threshold: protocol separates behaviour, pain, alternatives, and adoption signals; evidence_rationale: discovery must be structured before interpretation; cannot_support: PMF, WTP, procurement readiness, or adoption validation.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: discovery protocol not executed. Support: coded interviews. Revise: questions or target roles change. Invalidate: protocol cannot test target claims.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer adoption from stated interest.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ICP or buyer roles change.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.10 owns validation thresholds.

nodes.purpose: Define the specific questions and claims that the discovery protocol must test.
nodes.required_output: Discovery objective register: objective label, linked hypothesis, claim type, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.2 governing hypothesis, BP.4.4 ICP, internal architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1 for objective architecture; sufficiency_threshold: all discovery objectives are explicit, linked to falsifiable claims, and scoped to the candidate ICP; cannot_support: discovery completion, demand, adoption, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: discovery objectives not formalised. Support: completed objective register aligned with BP.2.5 hypothesis and BP.4.4 ICP.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat discovery objective completeness as evidence or claim validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if governing hypothesis, ICP, or target claims change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Objectives govern what discovery must test; they do not constitute evidence.

nodes.purpose: Define who must participate in discovery to generate evidence sufficient for governed claims.
nodes.required_output: Target participant register: participant type, ICP alignment criteria, minimum count, diversity requirements, and exclusion rules.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.4.4 ICP, BP.5 stakeholder architecture, internal architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1 for participant architecture, E4+ for recruited participants; sufficiency_threshold: participant types are linked to ICP and claims; cannot_support: participant representativeness, demand, adoption, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: target participant register not formalised. Support: ICP and stakeholder alignment review.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — discovery participant adequacy risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer demand or adoption from convenience-sample participants. Must not claim representativeness without diversity evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ICP or stakeholder architecture changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Participant definition only; recruitment and sufficiency routes to BP.10.

nodes.purpose: Define the jobs-to-be-done framework governing how user jobs, context, and outcomes are identified and coded.
nodes.required_output: JTBD framework specification: job taxonomy, functional/emotional/social job types, context coding rules, desired-outcome definition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal architecture, JTBD methodology reference; evidence_tier_required: E1 for framework architecture, E4+ for coded user jobs; sufficiency_threshold: JTBD framework is explicit and consistently applied to all discovery interviews; cannot_support: job universality, demand, adoption, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: JTBD framework not formalised. Support: methodology specification with coding rules.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim JTBD framework is user-validated or universally applicable without evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if user job definitions or coding rules change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Framework governs coding; does not produce evidence itself.

nodes.purpose: Define the structured interview protocol used to gather discovery evidence.
nodes.required_output: Interview protocol: question bank, question sequencing, probing rules, neutrality requirements, and recording/consent approach.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal architecture, JTBD framework; evidence_tier_required: E1 for protocol architecture; sufficiency_threshold: protocol is explicit, neutrally framed, and linked to discovery objectives; cannot_support: protocol effectiveness, adoption, demand, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: interview protocol not formalised. Support: completed question bank with probing rules.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not use leading questions that inflate pain or demand signals. Must not treat protocol existence as evidence collection.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if discovery objectives or JTBD framework changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Protocol definition only; execution and coding route to discovery activity.

nodes.purpose: Define the rules for coding and interpreting discovery interview data.
nodes.required_output: Coding rule register: code taxonomy, inter-rater rules, saturation criteria, signal-vs-noise distinctions, and prohibited interpretations.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal architecture, JTBD framework, BP.3 source governance; evidence_tier_required: E1 for coding architecture; sufficiency_threshold: coding rules are explicit and prevent demand, WTP, or adoption overclaiming from raw interview signals; cannot_support: coding accuracy, signal validity, demand, adoption, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: coding rules not formalised. Support: completed coding rule register aligned with JTBD framework.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat stated interest, enthusiasm, or pain acknowledgement as demand evidence during coding. Must not code compliments as WTP signals.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if JTBD framework or source governance changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Coding rules prevent interpretation overclaiming.

nodes.purpose: State all unvalidated assumptions underpinning the discovery protocol.
nodes.required_output: Discovery assumption register: each assumption, discovery component supported, labelled as unvalidated, with falsification conditions.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal architecture, assumption ledger; evidence_tier_required: E1 for candidate assumptions; sufficiency_threshold: all discovery protocol assumptions are explicit and falsifiable; cannot_support: assumption validity, evidence sufficiency, demand, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: assumption register not formalised.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat assumption completeness as protocol validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if protocol assumptions are contradicted by early discovery results.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption governance only.

nodes.purpose: Define evidence tier, source family, and sufficiency threshold required before discovery claims can support downstream architecture.
nodes.required_output: Discovery evidence requirements matrix: evidence tier per claim type, permitted sources, sufficiency thresholds, escalation routes.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Evidence Ladder, BP.3 source governance; evidence_tier_required: E1 for requirements architecture; sufficiency_threshold: each discovery claim type has documented evidence tier and source family; cannot_support: discovery validation, demand, adoption, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: evidence requirements matrix not defined.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — discovery evidence requirement gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat evidence requirements as discovery evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder or BP.3 governance changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Defines proof burden only.

nodes.purpose: Define all conclusions that discovery protocol evidence must never support.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited inference register for discovery protocol.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all prohibited discovery inferences explicitly documented; cannot_support: demand, adoption, WTP, PMF, or procurement readiness from protocol design or interview completion alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — prohibited discovery inference completeness
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer adoption from stated interest. Must not infer demand from pain acknowledgement. Must not infer WTP from enthusiasm or compliments.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new prohibited patterns emerge.
nodes.notes_limitations: Prohibitions are absolute.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.6.1 is internally coherent, complete, and free of prohibited inferences before discovery execution.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: discovery objectives, target participants, JTBD framework, interview protocol, coding rules, assumptions, evidence requirements, and prohibited inferences present and coherent.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.6.1.1–BP.6.1.8, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all nodes complete and non-contradictory; cannot_support: discovery results, demand, adoption, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller approval not recorded.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — discovery protocol acceptance gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat protocol acceptance as evidence collection or discovery validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.6.1 child changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architectural acceptance only; evidence collection routes to discovery execution.

nodes.purpose: Defines current user alternatives and behavioural baseline.
nodes.required_output: Alternatives map; current workflow evidence; substitution hypotheses.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: user interviews, observed workflow evidence; evidence_tier_required: E4+; sufficiency_threshold: alternatives are based on user-described or observed behaviour; evidence_rationale: alternatives define adoption context; cannot_support: willingness to switch, PMF, WTP, or procurement readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: current behaviour not evidenced. Support: workflow interviews/logs. Revise: alternatives differ. Invalidate: no relevant alternative identified.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer substitution from feature similarity alone.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if users report different alternatives.
nodes.notes_limitations: Status quo may be non-software.

nodes.purpose: Define the current workflow used by the target ICP before any product intervention.
nodes.required_output: Current workflow map: task sequence, decision points, tools used, handoffs, and workflow source evidence.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: user interviews, workflow observation, BP.1.3 workflow architecture; evidence_tier_required: E4+ for user-described workflow, E6+ for institutionally observed workflow; sufficiency_threshold: current workflow is described by participants, not assumed from product design; cannot_support: workflow adoption, demand, WTP, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: current workflow not evidenced from users. Support: coded interviews or workflow observation.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — current workflow evidence gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer the current workflow from product design assumptions. Must not claim the product improves workflow without evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if user workflow evidence changes or ICP redefines workflow.
nodes.notes_limitations: Evidence-based mapping only; does not establish adoption readiness.

nodes.purpose: Identify the tools, methods, or approaches currently used by the ICP instead of the product.
nodes.required_output: Current alternatives register: alternative label, description, user-described usage context, and evidence tier.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: user interviews, observed behaviour; evidence_tier_required: E4+; sufficiency_threshold: alternatives are described by users, not inferred from market research alone; cannot_support: willingness to switch, competitive superiority, demand, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: alternatives not evidenced from users. Support: coded discovery interviews.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — current alternative evidence gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer willingness to switch from feature comparison. Must not claim alternatives are inferior without user evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if users report different alternatives.
nodes.notes_limitations: User-reported alternatives only; does not validate switching intent.

nodes.purpose: Identify partial or indirect substitutes that address the same job without being direct product alternatives.
nodes.required_output: Substitute solution register: substitute label, job addressed, substitution mechanism, and evidence tier.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: user interviews, JTBD coding; evidence_tier_required: E4+; sufficiency_threshold: substitutes are linked to user-described jobs, not theoretical market mapping; cannot_support: substitution probability, competitive superiority, demand, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: substitute solutions not identified from user interviews. Support: JTBD-coded discovery.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — substitute solution evidence gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim substitutes are inferior or that users will abandon them without evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if JTBD coding reveals new substitutes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Substitute identification only; switching intent routes to BP.6.4.

nodes.purpose: Define the baseline behaviour the product must displace or augment.
nodes.required_output: Status quo behaviour description: behaviour pattern, frequency hypothesis, friction points, and evidence tier.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: user interviews, workflow observation; evidence_tier_required: E4+ for user-described behaviour; sufficiency_threshold: status quo behaviour is evidenced from participants and not inferred from assumptions; cannot_support: behaviour change intent, adoption, demand, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: status quo behaviour not evidenced. Support: coded interviews describing current practice.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — status quo behaviour evidence gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim status quo behaviour proves demand for change. Must not infer adoption intent from behaviour description.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if user behaviour evidence changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Baseline evidence only; adoption intent routes to BP.6.6.

nodes.purpose: State all unvalidated assumptions underpinning the current workflow and alternatives mapping.
nodes.required_output: Behavioural assumption register: assumption, component supported, labelled as unvalidated, with falsification conditions.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal architecture, assumption ledger; evidence_tier_required: E1 for candidate assumptions; sufficiency_threshold: all behavioural assumptions explicit and falsifiable; cannot_support: assumption validity, demand, or adoption.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: assumption register not formalised.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat assumption completeness as behavioural validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if discovery contradicts behavioural assumptions.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption governance only.

nodes.purpose: Identify the upstream conditions and contextual factors that determine which alternatives the ICP uses.
nodes.required_output: Alternative dependency map: alternative × prerequisite condition × dependency type × evidence required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: user interviews, JTBD coding; evidence_tier_required: E4+; sufficiency_threshold: dependencies are linked to user-described context, not assumed; cannot_support: dependency inevitability, adoption, demand, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: alternative dependencies not mapped.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim alternative usage is unconditional or universal.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if user context evidence reveals different dependencies.
nodes.notes_limitations: Dependency mapping only.

nodes.purpose: Define evidence tier and sufficiency threshold required before strengthening current behaviour claims.
nodes.required_output: Behaviour evidence requirements matrix.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Evidence Ladder, BP.3; evidence_tier_required: E1 for requirements architecture; sufficiency_threshold: each behaviour claim type has documented evidence tier; cannot_support: behaviour validation, demand, adoption, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: evidence requirements not defined.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — behaviour evidence requirement gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat evidence requirements as behaviour evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Defines proof burden only.

nodes.purpose: Define all conclusions that current behaviour and alternatives evidence must never support.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited inference register for behaviour and alternatives.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all prohibited inferences explicitly documented; cannot_support: willingness to switch, competitive superiority, demand, adoption, WTP, or PMF from behaviour evidence alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — prohibited behaviour inference completeness
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer willingness to switch from current behaviour frustration. Must not claim alternatives are inferior. Must not infer adoption from status quo pain.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new prohibited patterns emerge.
nodes.notes_limitations: Prohibitions are absolute.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.6.2 is internally coherent, complete, and free of prohibited inferences.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: current workflow, alternatives, substitutes, status quo behaviour, assumptions, dependencies, evidence requirements, and prohibited inferences present and coherent.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: completed BP.6.2.1–BP.6.2.8, architecture audit; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all nodes complete and non-contradictory; cannot_support: switching intent, demand, adoption, PMF, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller approval not recorded.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat alternatives acceptance as switching intent or demand validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.6.2 child changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architectural acceptance only.

nodes.purpose: Defines pain strength and barriers to adoption.
nodes.required_output: Pain/barrier matrix; evidence tier; stakeholder mapping.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: user interviews, buyer interviews, institutional evidence; evidence_tier_required: E4+ for user pain, E6+ for institutional barriers; sufficiency_threshold: pain and barriers are separately evidenced; evidence_rationale: pain does not equal adoption; cannot_support: WTP, PMF, procurement readiness, or commercial traction.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: pain/barrier evidence not collected. Support: coded discovery evidence. Revise: pain weak or barriers stronger. Invalidate: target pain absent.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer WTP or adoption from pain.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if discovery changes pain/barrier assessment.
nodes.notes_limitations: Pain is not demand.

nodes.purpose: Define the governed pain the product is hypothesised to address, traceable to BP.2.2.
nodes.required_output: Pain definition statement: pain label, affected actor, workflow location, and link to BP.2.2 pain architecture.
nodes.evidence_requirement: pain-definition evidence is required because this node governs how pain is described and bounded, without proving pain intensity, urgency, demand, WTP, adoption, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: pain definition not linked to BP.2.2. Support: BP.2.2 acceptance and user interview confirmation.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim pain definition proves demand, adoption, or WTP.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.2.2 pain architecture or user interview evidence changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Definition only; pain validation routes to discovery evidence.

nodes.purpose: Define and evidence the severity of governed pain for each affected stakeholder type.
nodes.required_output: Pain severity register: stakeholder type, severity level (trivial/moderate/significant/critical), evidence tier, and evidence source.
nodes.evidence_requirement: severity evidence is required because this node governs how reported pain is classified and compared, without converting pain into demand, willingness to pay, urgency, adoption readiness, or PMF.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: severity evidence not coded. Support: coded discovery with explicit severity signals.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — pain severity evidence gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not upgrade severity classification without meeting required evidence tier. Must not infer WTP from severity.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if discovery reveals different severity levels.
nodes.notes_limitations: Severity classification; WTP routes to BP.6.4.

nodes.purpose: Define how often the governed pain is experienced by the affected stakeholders.
nodes.required_output: Pain frequency register: stakeholder type, frequency hypothesis (daily/weekly/ad-hoc/event-triggered), evidence tier, and evidence source.
nodes.evidence_requirement: frequency evidence is required because this node governs how often the pain or workflow issue appears, without proving demand, retention, WTP, adoption likelihood, or PMF.

nodes.node_title: Business Model, Revenue, and GTM Logic
nodes.purpose: Governs the business model hypothesis, pricing, GTM motion, sales cycle, unit economics, and financial viability without validating market demand, customer acquisition success, or commercial readiness.
nodes.required_output: BP.9 node set covering value creation/delivery/capture logic, pricing hypothesis, GTM first motion, sales cycle, unit economics, financial model, and financial viability gate.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1–BP.8 internal architecture dependencies, founder hypothesis; evidence_tier_required: E1 for architecture; sufficiency_threshold: BP.9 defines business model and GTM architecture without populating or validating revenue, customer acquisition, retention, or market pull; evidence_rationale: BP.9 controls how business model claims may be used across BP.1–BP.11; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, customer acquisition success, retention, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, investor readiness, or revenue adequacy.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no customer acquisition evidence populated. Support: BP.10 GTM pilot with measured CAC and acquisition rate. Revise: if revenue drivers, pricing, GTM motion, or unit economics assumptions change.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — business-model-viability uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — revenue-driver risk; BP.12 candidate — GTM-channel-fit uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — unit-economics-sustainability risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat business model architecture as validation of revenue potential, customer acquisition success, unit economics viability, pricing acceptance, GTM effectiveness, or commercial readiness. Must not infer adoption from business model coherence.
nodes.dependencies: BP.1; BP.2; BP.4; BP.5; BP.6; BP.8
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if value proposition changes, pricing strategy changes, GTM motion changes, sales process changes, unit economics drivers change, or financial assumptions are contradicted.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.9 governs business model logic; revenue validation routes to BP.10 pilot; financial compliance routes to BP.7; customer acquisition validation routes to BP.10 GTM pilot.

nodes.node_title: Value Creation, Delivery, and Capture Logic
nodes.purpose: Defines the hypothesised mechanism by which EpistemicOS creates value, delivers it to users, and captures value for the business without validating demand, user adoption, willingness to pay, or market viability.
nodes.required_output: Value creation packet covering value proposition definition, value creation logic, value delivery logic, value capture logic, business model assumptions, business model dependencies, value logic evidence requirements, prohibited business model inferences, and value creation/capture acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1 product definition, BP.1.3 workflow definition, BP.2.1 problem statement, BP.5 user/buyer/institutional stakeholder architecture, founder hypothesis; evidence_tier_required: E1 for value architecture; sufficiency_threshold: BP.9.1.1–BP.9.1.9 are present, coherent, non-contradictory, and do not contradict BP.1 product scope, BP.1.3 workflow scope, or BP.2 problem scope; evidence_rationale: value creation architecture is internal product/business logic grounded in product definition and problem scope; cannot_support: demand, user adoption, willingness to pay, procurement readiness, PMF, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no user-validated value experience evidence populated. Support: BP.6 discovery interviews revealing user-perceived value; BP.10 pilot value signals and behavior change. Revise: if users experience value differently than hypothesised or identify different value sources.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — value-creation-validity uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — value-perception-mismatch risk; BP.12 candidate — value-delivery-usability risk; BP.12 candidate — capture-model-acceptability risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim users perceive value, will adopt, will pay, or will renew based on value architecture alone. Must not treat value hypothesis as validated demand or adoption likelihood. Must not infer WTP from value creation mechanism.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.1.1 product definition changes, BP.1.3 workflow scope changes, BP.2.1 problem definition changes, BP.5 stakeholder map changes, or discovery reveals users frame value differently.
nodes.notes_limitations: Value architecture defines internal product logic; value perception and adoption validation routes to BP.6 discovery and BP.10 pilot. Value delivery usability validation routes to BP.10 pilot.

nodes.purpose: State the core value proposition without implying demand, adoption, or willingness to pay.
nodes.required_output: One-sentence value proposition statement identifying: the problem solved + affected stakeholder type (user/buyer/institution) + workflow context + expected impact on that stakeholder.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1.1 product definition, BP.2.1 problem statement, founder hypothesis; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: value proposition is stated as a bounded, falsifiable architecture statement and is coherent with BP.1.1 product scope, BP.1.3 intended workflow scope, and BP.2.1 problem scope; evidence_rationale: value proposition is internal product positioning logic grounded in product and problem architecture; cannot_support: user demand, adoption intent, willingness to pay, perceived value without separate evidence, market viability, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no user-validated value perception evidence. Support: BP.6 discovery interviews with users/buyers confirming value framing; BP.10 pilot user behavior indicating value perception. Revise: if users identify different problem or different solution priority.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — value-proposition-clarity uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — value-user-mismatch risk; BP.12 candidate — value-framing-adoption-gap risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim value is perceived by users, will drive adoption, justifies pricing, or is universally desired. Must not conflate value hypothesis with market demand.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.1.1 product definition changes, BP.2.1 problem scope changes, BP.5 stakeholder roles change, or discovery reveals users/buyers frame value proposition differently.
nodes.notes_limitations: Value proposition is architecture statement, not market validation. User value perception, adoption likelihood, and WTP route to BP.6 discovery and BP.10 pilot.

nodes.purpose: Explain the hypothesised mechanism by which the product creates the claimed value in the intended user workflow.
nodes.required_output: Value creation mechanism narrative: input state → diagnostic process → output state → human judgment point → outcome boundary (what the system does not decide).
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1.1 product definition, BP.1.3 workflow definition, BP.1.1.5 diagnostic output specification, founder hypothesis; evidence_tier_required: E1 for mechanism architecture; sufficiency_threshold: value creation mechanism is explicitly defined, input→output flow is traceable through workflow stages, and mechanism does not exceed BP.1.1 product scope or BP.1.2 non-scope exclusions; evidence_rationale: mechanism is internal product architecture logic; cannot_support: mechanism validity, mechanism effectiveness, user adoption, user will use mechanism, output sufficiency, or value realization.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no user workflow observation or workflow adoption evidence. Support: BP.10 pilot user workflow observation showing users follow mechanism and produce expected output. Revise: if user workflow deviates from intended mechanism or workflow adoption is lower than expected.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — value-mechanism-validity uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — workflow-adoption-risk; BP.12 candidate — mechanism-effectiveness-gap risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim mechanism is effective, validated, or will be adopted by users. Must not infer user behavior from mechanism design. Must not claim mechanism will produce value without separate user evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.1.1 product scope changes, BP.1.3 workflow changes, BP.1.1.5 output specification changes, or discovery reveals users cannot/will not follow intended mechanism.
nodes.notes_limitations: Mechanism is hypothetical product logic; effectiveness validation and user adoption validation route to BP.10 pilot.

nodes.purpose: Define how the value is made accessible to users (delivery modality, integration path, user responsibility).
nodes.required_output: Value delivery model specification: primary modality (SaaS UI / API / email report / institutional dashboard integration / direct link) + user workflow integration point + accessibility boundary + user-side responsibilities + institutional integration assumptions.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1.3 workflow specification, BP.1.4 product boundary, technical architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1 for delivery architecture; sufficiency_threshold: delivery modality is explicit, integration point is traceable to BP.1.3 workflow, delivery does not exceed BP.1.4 product boundary, and accessibility assumptions are documented; evidence_rationale: delivery modality is product architecture component; cannot_support: delivery is user-preferred, institutional integration is feasible, user adoption of modality, delivery is scalable, or institutional procurements will accept modality.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no user integration usability or acceptance evidence. Support: BP.6 discovery feedback on delivery modality preference; BP.10 pilot integration usability metrics (time-to-activate, error rates). Revise: if users struggle with modality or prefer different delivery channel.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — delivery-mechanism-mismatch risk; BP.12 candidate — user-adoption-of-delivery-risk; BP.12 candidate — institutional-integration-feasibility risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim delivery modality is user-preferred, institutionally viable, scalable, or will drive adoption. Must not infer user satisfaction from delivery modality availability.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.1.3 workflow changes, BP.1.4 product boundary changes, delivery modality changes, or discovery reveals users strongly prefer different delivery channel.
nodes.notes_limitations: Delivery model is architectural; user usability, integration feasibility, and modality preference validation route to BP.10 pilot. Institutional integration readiness routes to BP.7 (compliance/deployability).

nodes.purpose: Define how the business captures economic return from the value created (revenue source, payment trigger, buyer identification).
nodes.required_output: Value capture model: monetization unit (per-manuscript / per-user / per-institution / per-API-call / hybrid) + payment trigger (subscription start / per-use / annual renewal / one-time license) + who pays (researcher / institution / journal / funder / procurement authority) + capture modality (direct payment / procurement process / grant funds / research budget line) + revenue recognition timing.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.5 user/buyer/institutional stakeholder architecture, BP.4 market structure and buyer authority, founder hypothesis; evidence_tier_required: E1 for capture architecture; sufficiency_threshold: capture model identifies how economic return flows from value delivery to business, monetization unit is bounded and distinct, buyer type is identified per monetization unit, and capture does not exceed BP.5 stakeholder boundaries; evidence_rationale: capture logic is business architecture component grounded in stakeholder structure; cannot_support: buyers will pay, pricing adequacy, revenue sustainability, pricing acceptance, procurement authority acceptance, or market fit.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no buyer-validated willingness-to-pay evidence or institutional procurement cycle evidence. Support: BP.6 discovery interviews with decision-makers revealing budget authority and payment trigger acceptance; BP.4 market structure analysis confirming buyer types and procurement patterns. Revise: if institutional procurement authority differs from hypothesis or buyer types lack budget.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — capture-model-viability uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — buyer-acceptance-risk; BP.12 candidate — institutional-procurement-authority-gap risk; BP.12 candidate — revenue-sustainability-risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim buyers will pay, can afford, possess budget authority, will accept payment trigger, or will renew without separate evidence. Must not conflate capture model design with WTP validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.5 stakeholder/buyer role changes, BP.4 market structure changes, institutional procurement authority differs from assumption, or discovery reveals budget constraints.
nodes.notes_limitations: Capture logic is hypothetical business model component; WTP validation routes to BP.6 discovery and BP.9.2 pricing hypothesis. Institutional procurement readiness routes to BP.7 (compliance/deployability).

nodes.purpose: State all unvalidated assumptions underpinning value creation, delivery, and capture without treating assumptions as evidence.
nodes.required_output: Business model assumption register in table format: assumption + component supported (creation/delivery/capture) + labelled as unvalidated + falsification condition + support/revise/invalidate evidence trigger.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal architecture, founder hypothesis, assumption ledger; evidence_tier_required: E1 for assumption register; sufficiency_threshold: all major business model assumptions (user value perception, delivery feasibility, buyer acceptance, institutional procurement) are explicit, labelled as unvalidated, and linked to falsification conditions; evidence_rationale: assumption governance prevents hidden overclaiming and identifies what must be tested; cannot_support: assumption validity, assumption sufficiency, business model viability, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: assumption register not formalized. Support: completed assumption ledger with falsification conditions per assumption. Revise: if discovery validates or contradicts assumptions. Invalidate: if assumptions are unstated or non-falsifiable.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — business-model-assumption completeness; BP.12 candidate — hidden-business-model-assumption risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat assumption completeness as assumption validation. Must not present business model assumptions as facts or confirmed observations. Must not infer adoption from assumption documentation.
nodes.dependencies: BP.9.1.1; BP.9.1.2; BP.9.1.3; BP.9.1.4; BP.6 (discovery validation); BP.10 (pilot validation)
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if discovery evidence validates, revises, or invalidates any business model assumption, or new assumptions are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption governance prevents hidden overclaiming; assumption validation routes to BP.6 discovery and BP.10 pilot.

nodes.purpose: Identify all upstream architecture nodes and downstream validation domains that value creation, delivery, and capture logic depends on.
nodes.required_output: Business model dependency map in table format: upstream node + dependency type (necessary/sufficient) + downstream validation domain (BP.6/BP.10/BP.5/BP.7) + reopen trigger if dependency changes.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.1–BP.9 internal architecture, BP.6 discovery design, BP.10 validation design; evidence_tier_required: E1 for dependency architecture; sufficiency_threshold: all upstream dependencies (BP.1.1, BP.1.3, BP.2.1, BP.5, BP.4) are identified and traced, all downstream dependencies (BP.6 discovery validation, BP.10 pilot validation) are explicit and non-circular; evidence_rationale: dependency mapping prevents business model claims that outrun their architectural conditions; cannot_support: dependency validity, dependency sufficiency, business model viability, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: dependency map not formalized. Support: completed dependency register aligned with BP.1–BP.10. Revise: if upstream architecture changes or downstream validation requirements emerge. Invalidate: if dependencies are circular or create unfalsifiable conditions.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — business-model-dependency clarity; BP.12 candidate — hidden-dependency-risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat dependency completeness as business model validation. Must not create circular dependencies that prevent falsification.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if upstream architecture (BP.1/BP.2/BP.5/BP.4) changes, downstream validation design (BP.6/BP.10) changes, or new dependencies emerge.
nodes.notes_limitations: Dependency mapping prevents hidden assumptions; dependency satisfaction routes to upstream domains (BP.1–BP.5) and downstream validation (BP.6/BP.10).

nodes.purpose: Define the evidence type, tier, source family, and sufficiency threshold required before strengthening value creation and capture claims beyond candidate status.
nodes.required_output: Value logic evidence requirements matrix in table format: value claim type (value proposition / creation mechanism / delivery feasibility / capture acceptability) × evidence tier (E1–E7) × permitted source families × sufficiency threshold × escalation routes to BP.3/BP.6/BP.10/BP.12.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, Evidence Ladder, BP.3 source governance, BP.6 discovery design, BP.10 pilot design; evidence_tier_required: E1 for evidence-requirement architecture; sufficiency_threshold: each value claim type has documented evidence tier, permitted source family, and sufficiency threshold aligned with Evidence Ladder and BP.3 rules; evidence_rationale: evidence requirements define proof burden before claim strengthening and prevent tier inflation; cannot_support: claim validity, business model viability, demand, adoption, PMF, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.

nodes.node_title: Value Creation and Capture Acceptance Check

nodes.node_title: Validation, Behavioural Evidence, and PMF Decision Logic
nodes.purpose: Governs validation strategy, pilot design, behavioural evidence, workflow-triggered use, PMF evidence path, decision thresholds, learning logic, and reopen rules.
nodes.required_output: BP.10 Level 2 node set covering validation strategy/pilot design, behavioural evidence/workflow-triggered use, PMF evidence path, decision thresholds, learning logic/reopen rules, and validation decision gate.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.1–BP.9 architecture, pilot evidence, behavioural evidence, commercial evidence, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E1 for validation architecture, E4+ for behavioural signal evidence, E6/E7 for commercial/PMF evidence; sufficiency_threshold: BP.10 defines validation design, evidence thresholds, decision criteria, and learning logic without self-assigning PMF, validation success, or commercial readiness; evidence_rationale: validation requires designed evidence collection and explicit decision criteria, not retrospective rationalisation; cannot_support: PMF certainty, commercial readiness, investor readiness, or revenue certainty from architecture alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: validation strategy, behavioural evidence, PMF evidence, decision thresholds, and learning logic are not populated. Support: pilot, behavioural, and commercial evidence collected per design. Revise: validation design, behavioural metrics, PMF thresholds, or decision criteria change. Invalidate: no credible validation path can be designed or sustained.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — validation-design gap; BP.12 candidate — behavioural-evidence uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — PMF-evidence gap; BP.12 candidate — decision-threshold uncertainty; BP.12 candidate — learning-logic gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not self-assign PMF, validation success, or commercial readiness from architecture coherence. Must not infer behavioural success from engagement vanity metrics or PMF from isolated positive signals.
nodes.dependencies: BP.1; BP.4; BP.5; BP.6; BP.7; BP.9
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if validation design, pilot scope, behavioural metrics, PMF thresholds, decision criteria, or learning rules change.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.10 designs and governs validation evidence and decision logic; it does not itself constitute PMF or commercial validation.

nodes.purpose: Defines validation objectives, hypotheses, pilot design, and scope without asserting validation outcomes.
nodes.required_output: Validation objective register; hypothesis register; pilot design specification; scope boundary; validation strategy acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.1 problem/solution, BP.4 ICP, BP.6 discovery, BP.9 business model; evidence_tier_required: E1 for design architecture, E4+ for pilot-feasibility confirmation; sufficiency_threshold: validation strategy is hypothesis-linked, scope-bounded, and designed prior to evidence collection; evidence_rationale: validation design must precede evidence interpretation to avoid retrospective rationalisation; cannot_support: validation success, PMF, behavioural confirmation, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: validation strategy and pilot design not populated. Support: completed pilot design reviewed against hypotheses. Revise: if ICP, problem definition, or business model changes. Invalidate: no testable pilot design can be constructed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim validation success or PMF from pilot design alone. Must not redesign hypotheses retroactively to fit observed results.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ICP, problem/solution scope, or business model assumptions change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Design only; pilot execution and evidence collection occur downstream.

nodes.purpose: Define the specific objectives the validation effort is designed to test, in bounded and falsifiable terms.
nodes.required_output: Validation objective register: objective statement, linked hypothesis, success/failure criteria, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.1.1 problem/solution, BP.9.1 value logic, BP.6 discovery evidence; evidence_tier_required: E1 for objective definition; sufficiency_threshold: objectives are falsifiable, bounded, and linked to a specific business model or adoption hypothesis; evidence_rationale: objectives must be defined before evidence collection to prevent post-hoc rationalisation; cannot_support: validation success, PMF, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: validation objectives not defined in falsifiable terms. Support: objective register linked to specific hypotheses. Revise: if problem definition or business model changes. Invalidate: objectives cannot be made falsifiable.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not state objectives in unfalsifiable terms. Must not retrofit objectives to match observed outcomes.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if problem/solution scope, ICP, or business model hypotheses change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Objective definition only; success determination occurs after evidence collection.

nodes.purpose: State the specific, falsifiable hypotheses that the validation pilot is designed to test, prior to evidence collection.
nodes.required_output: Validation hypothesis register: hypothesis statement, hypothesis type, falsification condition, linked BP node, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.1 problem/solution architecture, BP.6 discovery, BP.9 business model assumptions; evidence_tier_required: E1 for hypothesis definition; sufficiency_threshold: hypotheses are explicit, falsifiable, and stated prior to pilot execution; evidence_rationale: pre-registration of hypotheses prevents retrospective fitting of evidence to conclusions; cannot_support: hypothesis confirmation, PMF, or validation success.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: validation hypotheses not pre-registered in falsifiable form. Support: hypothesis register completed before pilot launch. Revise: if upstream assumptions or business model logic changes. Invalidate: hypotheses cannot be made falsifiable.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not introduce new hypotheses after evidence collection to explain unexpected results without explicit revision logging.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if upstream assumptions, problem definition, or business model changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Pre-registration only; confirmation or falsification occurs after evidence collection.

nodes.purpose: Define the structure of the validation pilot, including participants, duration, intervention, and observation method, without asserting representativeness.
nodes.required_output: Pilot design specification: participant criteria, sample size rationale, duration, intervention description, observation method, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.4.4 ICP, BP.5.1 role map, internal pilot planning; evidence_tier_required: E1 for design architecture, E4+ for pilot-feasibility confirmation; sufficiency_threshold: pilot design specifies participants, method, and duration without asserting that the pilot sample is representative of the broader market; evidence_rationale: pilot design structures evidence collection and bounds claim generalisability; cannot_support: market representativeness, PMF, demand certainty, or commercial readiness.

nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ICP, target population, or pilot feasibility constraints change.

nodes.purpose: Define the explicit boundaries of what the validation effort can and cannot determine, including population, time horizon, and claim limits.
nodes.required_output: Validation scope statement: in-scope claims, out-of-scope claims, population boundary, time horizon, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.10.1.1 objectives, BP.10.1.3 pilot design, Architecture Governance Rules; evidence_tier_required: E1 for scope definition; sufficiency_threshold: scope explicitly states claim limits and excludes claims the pilot is not designed to support; evidence_rationale: scope boundaries prevent overgeneralisation of pilot results; cannot_support: claims outside the explicitly defined scope, including PMF or market-wide demand.

nodes.purpose: State all unvalidated assumptions underpinning the validation strategy and pilot design with explicit falsification conditions.
nodes.required_output: Validation assumption register: assumption, design component supported, labelled unvalidated, falsification condition, support/revise/invalidate triggers.

nodes.purpose: Identify upstream conditions and architectural dependencies that must be satisfied before validation pilot design can be executed.

nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because pilot-design assumptions and dependencies must be explicit before validation planning can be reviewed, without treating the plan as evidence that validation has occurred.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: validation dependency map not completed. Support: cross-branch dependency review. Revise: if upstream architecture changes. Invalidate: circular or unresolvable dependencies found.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim validation dependencies resolved without upstream confirmation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ICP, buying system, business model, or compliance context changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Dependency mapping only.

nodes.purpose: Define evidence type, tier, source family, and sufficiency threshold required before strengthening any validation strategy claim.
nodes.required_output: Validation evidence requirements matrix: evidence tier per claim type, permitted source families, sufficiency thresholds, escalation routes.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because the node defines what evidence would be required during pilot validation, not whether that evidence already exists or is sufficient for PMF, diagnostic accuracy, or commercial claims.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: validation evidence requirements not defined. Support: Evidence Ladder applied per validation claim type. Revise: if Ladder thresholds change. Invalidate: requirements conflict with BP.3.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — validation evidence requirement gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat evidence requirements as validation evidence itself.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder or governance standards change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Defines proof burden only.

nodes.purpose: Define all conclusions that validation strategy and pilot design architecture must never support, regardless of evidence quantity.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited validation inference register: prohibited conclusion, protected design component, escalation trigger if violated.
nodes.evidence_requirement: governance-rule evidence is required because this node prevents pilot design, participant selection, or planned metrics from being misused as pilot evidence, PMF evidence, diagnostic validation, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated. Support: completed prohibition matrix. Revise: if new prohibited patterns emerge. Invalidate: prohibitions are internally contradictory.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim PMF, validation success, or commercial readiness from pilot design alone.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new prohibited patterns emerge or narrative implies prohibited validation inferences.
nodes.notes_limitations: Prohibitions are absolute; design coherence does not equal validation success.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.10.1 is internally coherent, complete, and free of prohibited inferences before behavioural evidence architecture proceeds.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: objectives, hypotheses, pilot design, scope, assumptions, dependencies, evidence requirements, and prohibited inferences present, coherent, and non-contradictory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed pilot-design child nodes, architecture audit, and controller review are required because this node accepts pilot-design architecture only, not pilot validity, PMF, diagnostic accuracy, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller approval not recorded. Support: completed architecture review. Revise: if any BP.10.1 child changes. Invalidate: if contradictions remain or pilot design is infeasible.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat validation strategy acceptance as validation success or PMF.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.10.1 child changes or pilot feasibility is contradicted.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only gate.

nodes.purpose: Define how diagnostic outputs will be compared against expert judgment and reviewer-feedback references.
nodes.required_output: Benchmark protocol with comparison artifacts, expert roles, reviewer-feedback use rules, metrics, thresholds, false-positive/false-negative handling, and failure conditions.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed design evidence and controller review are required because this node governs readiness to proceed within validation architecture, not whether the product has been validated or is ready for market.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: Benchmark method covers each MVP diagnostic capability and states prohibited claims. not yet satisfied. Support: acceptance_criteria met — Benchmark method covers each MVP diagnostic capability and states prohibited claims. Revise: scope or dependencies listed change. Invalidate: acceptance criteria cannot be met after revision.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to claim senior-reviewer reliability, publication improvement, reduced rejection risk, PMF, or commercial traction.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if diagnostic capabilities, target field, benchmark corpus, reviewer-feedback access, or pilot design changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: acceptance_criteria: Benchmark method covers each MVP diagnostic capability and states prohibited claims.

nodes.purpose: Defines behavioural success metrics and workflow-trigger evidence requirements without asserting adoption or PMF.
nodes.required_output: Behavioural metric register; workflow trigger map; observation framework; measurement logic; behavioural evidence acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.10.1 pilot design, BP.6 discovery, behavioural/usage data; evidence_tier_required: E4+ for behavioural-confirmed evidence; sufficiency_threshold: behavioural metrics are pre-defined, observable, and distinguish genuine workflow-triggered use from novelty or coerced use; evidence_rationale: behavioural evidence is stronger than self-report but still bounded; cannot_support: PMF, demand certainty, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: behavioural metrics and workflow triggers not pre-defined or measured. Support: observed usage data matching pre-defined metrics. Revise: if workflow assumptions or usage context changes. Invalidate: behavioural metrics show no workflow-triggered use.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer adoption or PMF from vanity engagement metrics (e.g., logins, page views) absent workflow-triggered use evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if workflow assumptions, usage context, or pilot population changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Behavioural evidence informs but does not establish PMF; PMF logic is governed in BP.10.3.

nodes.purpose: Define the specific, observable behavioural metrics that would indicate workflow-triggered use, pre-registered prior to pilot execution.
nodes.required_output: Behavioural metric register: metric name, behaviour observed, measurement method, threshold (if any), and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.6.3 pain/JTBD evidence, BP.10.1.2 validation hypotheses, product usage architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1 for metric definition, E4+ for metric-confirmed evidence; sufficiency_threshold: metrics are pre-registered, observable, and behaviourally specific rather than vanity-based; evidence_rationale: pre-registration of metrics prevents retrospective metric selection to fit favourable outcomes; cannot_support: PMF, adoption certainty, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: behavioural success metrics not pre-registered. Support: metric register completed before pilot launch. Revise: if JTBD or workflow assumptions change. Invalidate: no observable behavioural metric can be defined.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not select or redefine metrics after observing pilot results.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if JTBD, workflow assumptions, or product usage architecture changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Pre-registration only; threshold satisfaction assessed after data collection.

nodes.purpose: Define what constitutes a genuine workflow-triggered use event as distinct from novelty use, coerced use, or testing activity.
nodes.required_output: Workflow trigger definition: trigger event, workflow context, distinguishing criteria from non-genuine use, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.6.3 JTBD evidence, BP.5.1 role map, product usage architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1 for definition, E4+ for trigger-confirmed evidence; sufficiency_threshold: workflow trigger is explicitly distinguished from novelty, coerced, or test use; evidence_rationale: trigger definition prevents overcounting non-genuine usage as adoption signal; cannot_support: adoption certainty, PMF, or demand.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: workflow trigger definition not distinguished from non-genuine use. Support: usage data reviewed against trigger definition criteria. Revise: if workflow context or JTBD changes. Invalidate: genuine workflow triggers cannot be distinguished from non-genuine use.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not count novelty, coerced, or test use as workflow-triggered evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if workflow context, JTBD, or usage patterns change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Definition only; classification of observed events occurs during measurement.

nodes.purpose: Define the pre/post comparison methodology for pilot evaluation without asserting improvement, causality, diagnostic accuracy, or PMF.
nodes.required_output: Behavioural observation framework: data source, collection method, observation period, recording mechanism, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.10.1.3 pilot design, product instrumentation, internal data architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1 for framework design, E4+ for instrumentation-confirmed data collection; sufficiency_threshold: observation framework specifies method and period without asserting data completeness or accuracy; evidence_rationale: observation framework structures evidence collection and bounds data reliability claims; cannot_support: data completeness, PMF, or behavioural certainty.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: observation framework not specified with method and period. Support: framework reviewed for instrumentation feasibility. Revise: if pilot design or instrumentation capability changes. Invalidate: no feasible observation framework can be constructed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not assert data completeness or accuracy without instrumentation confirmation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if pilot design, instrumentation capability, or observation period changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Framework design only; data quality assessed after collection.

nodes.purpose: Define the logic by which observed behavioural data will be analysed and interpreted against pre-defined metrics and thresholds.
nodes.required_output: Behavioural measurement logic statement: analysis method, threshold application logic, confounder controls, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.10.2.1 success metrics, BP.10.2.3 observation framework; evidence_tier_required: E1 for logic design, E4+ for analysis-confirmed application; sufficiency_threshold: measurement logic is pre-defined, applies pre-registered thresholds, and accounts for known confounders without asserting causal certainty; evidence_rationale: measurement logic prevents post-hoc reinterpretation of ambiguous data; cannot_support: causal certainty, PMF, or adoption certainty.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: measurement logic not pre-defined with confounder controls. Support: measurement logic applied consistently to collected data. Revise: if metrics, observation framework, or known confounders change. Invalidate: measurement logic cannot distinguish signal from noise.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not reinterpret ambiguous behavioural data to fit a desired conclusion after the fact.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if success metrics, observation framework, or confounder landscape changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Logic design only; application occurs during evidence analysis.

nodes.purpose: State all unvalidated assumptions underpinning the behavioural evidence architecture with explicit falsification conditions.
nodes.required_output: Behavioural assumption register: assumption, behavioural component supported, labelled unvalidated, falsification condition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because the node governs how behavioural or pilot evidence will be captured and interpreted, without proving adoption, repeated use, workflow integration, PMF, or commercial validation.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: behavioural assumption register not formalised. Support: assumption ledger with falsification conditions. Revise: if behavioural data contradicts assumptions. Invalidate: assumptions are non-falsifiable.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat behavioural assumption completeness as behavioural validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if behavioural data, workflow context, or usage patterns change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption governance only.

nodes.purpose: Identify upstream conditions and architectural dependencies that must be satisfied before behavioural evidence can be collected and interpreted.
nodes.required_output: Behavioural dependency map: dependency type, prerequisite condition, dependency owner, evidence required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because behavioural metrics and thresholds must be specified before evidence can be interpreted, but metric definition does not establish that the threshold has been met.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: behavioural dependency map not completed. Support: cross-branch dependency review. Revise: if upstream architecture changes. Invalidate: circular or unresolvable dependencies found.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim behavioural dependencies resolved without upstream confirmation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if pilot design, JTBD evidence, or instrumentation capability changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Dependency mapping only.

nodes.purpose: Define evidence type, tier, source family, and sufficiency threshold required before strengthening any behavioural evidence claim.
nodes.required_output: Behavioural evidence requirements matrix: evidence tier per behavioural claim type, permitted sources, sufficiency thresholds, escalation routes.

nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: behavioural evidence requirements not defined. Support: Evidence Ladder applied per behavioural claim type. Revise: if Ladder thresholds change. Invalidate: requirements conflict with BP.3.

nodes.purpose: Define all conclusions that behavioural evidence architecture must never support, regardless of evidence quantity.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited behavioural inference register: prohibited conclusion, protected behavioural component, escalation trigger.
nodes.evidence_requirement: governance-rule evidence is required because this node prevents behavioural signals, pilot participation, usage events, or testimonial material from being misused as PMF, procurement readiness, renewal, or commercial validation.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated. Support: completed prohibition matrix. Revise: if new prohibited patterns emerge. Invalidate: prohibitions are contradictory.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer PMF or demand certainty from vanity metrics, novelty use, or short observation windows.
