nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.10.2 is internally coherent, complete, and free of prohibited inferences before PMF evidence path architecture proceeds.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: success metrics, trigger definition, observation framework, measurement logic, assumptions, dependencies, evidence requirements, and prohibited inferences present, coherent, and non-contradictory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10.2 child nodes, architecture audit, and controller review are required because this node accepts behavioural-evidence architecture only, not validated adoption, workflow embedding, PMF, or commercial traction.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller approval not recorded. Support: completed architecture review. Revise: if any BP.10.2 child changes. Invalidate: if contradictions remain.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat behavioural evidence acceptance as PMF or adoption validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.10.2 child changes or behavioural data contradicts the architecture.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only gate.

nodes.purpose: Defines the staged evidence framework required before PMF can be claimed, without self-assigning PMF status.
nodes.required_output: PMF stage register; behavioural threshold register; commercial threshold register; PMF evidence acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.10.2 behavioural evidence, BP.9 commercial evidence, controller review; evidence_tier_required: E4+ for behavioural-stage evidence, E6/E7 for commercial-stage evidence; sufficiency_threshold: PMF stages and thresholds are pre-defined and evidence-gated; evidence_rationale: PMF claims require staged, multi-source evidence rather than single-signal inference; cannot_support: PMF certainty, investor readiness, or commercial certainty.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: PMF stage definitions and thresholds not populated. Support: staged evidence collected against pre-defined thresholds. Revise: if behavioural or commercial evidence changes. Invalidate: thresholds cannot be met across required stages.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not declare PMF from a single positive signal, isolated cohort, or anecdotal enthusiasm.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if behavioural metrics, commercial evidence, or PMF thresholds change.
nodes.notes_limitations: PMF status requires controller-reviewed, multi-stage evidence; this section defines the evidentiary path, not the determination.

nodes.purpose: Define the overall framework by which PMF evidence will be assessed, including evidence categories and their relative weight.
nodes.required_output: PMF evidence framework: evidence category, weight/role in assessment, minimum threshold per category, and evidence tier required.

nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: PMF evidence framework not defined prior to evidence collection. Support: framework reviewed and approved by controller before assessment begins. nodes.notes_limitations: Framework design only; determination occurs at BP.10.3.9/BP.10.4.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.10.2.1 behavioural success metrics, BP.10.3.2 stage definitions; evidence_tier_required: E1 for threshold definition, E4+ for threshold-confirmed evidence; sufficiency_threshold: thresholds are quantified and pre-registered without being adjusted to match observed results; evidence_rationale: pre-registered thresholds prevent retrospective threshold-lowering to claim success; cannot_support: PMF or adoption certainty from threshold definition alone.

nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if behavioural metrics, measurement methodology, or PMF stages change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Threshold definition only; attainment assessed after evidence collection.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.9.4 revenue path, BP.9.5 unit economics, BP.10.3.2 stage definitions; evidence_tier_required: E1 for threshold definition, E6/E7 for threshold-confirmed commercial evidence; sufficiency_threshold: commercial thresholds are quantified and pre-registered without being adjusted to match observed results; evidence_rationale: pre-registered commercial thresholds prevent retrospective threshold-lowering to claim commercial PMF; cannot_support: PMF, revenue certainty, or investor readiness from threshold definition alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: commercial thresholds not quantified and pre-registered. Support: threshold register reviewed and locked before evidence collection. Revise: if revenue model, unit economics, or PMF stages change. Invalidate: no defensible commercial threshold can be set.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not lower or adjust commercial thresholds after observing results to manufacture a pass.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if revenue model, unit economics, or PMF stages change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Threshold definition only; attainment assessed after evidence collection.

nodes.purpose: State all unvalidated assumptions underpinning the PMF evidence path with explicit falsification conditions.
nodes.required_output: PMF assumption register: assumption, PMF component supported, labelled unvalidated, falsification condition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: this evidence is required because the node governs diagnostic-evaluation design and evidence routing, not diagnostic accuracy, reviewer equivalence, publication improvement, or product effectiveness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: PMF assumption register not formalised. Support: assumption ledger with falsification conditions. Revise: if behavioural or commercial evidence contradicts assumptions. Invalidate: assumptions are non-falsifiable.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat PMF assumption completeness as PMF validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if behavioural or commercial evidence contradicts PMF assumptions.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption governance only.

nodes.purpose: Identify upstream conditions and architectural dependencies that must be satisfied before PMF evidence can be assessed.

nodes.evidence_requirement: assumption evidence is required because diagnostic-evaluation design may depend on untested assumptions about manuscripts, reviewers, benchmarks, coding rules, and evaluation conditions that must remain explicit.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: PMF dependency map not completed. Support: cross-branch dependency review. Revise: if upstream architecture changes. Invalidate: circular or unresolvable dependencies found.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim PMF dependencies resolved without upstream confirmation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if behavioural evidence, commercial architecture, or revenue path changes.

nodes.purpose: Define evidence type, tier, source family, and sufficiency threshold required before strengthening any PMF claim.

nodes.evidence_requirement: validation evidence requirements are needed because diagnostic-performance claims require structured evaluation evidence, and cannot be inferred from product architecture, expert opinion, or pilot design alone.

nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated. Support: completed prohibition matrix. Revise: if new prohibited patterns emerge. Invalidate: prohibitions are contradictory.

nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10.3 child nodes, architecture audit, and controller review are required because this node accepts diagnostic-evaluation architecture only, not diagnostic accuracy, reviewer equivalence, or publication-outcome improvement.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller approval not recorded. Support: completed architecture review. Revise: if any BP.10.3 child changes. Invalidate: if contradictions remain or thresholds were retroactively altered.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat PMF evidence path acceptance as PMF attainment.

nodes.purpose: Defines the decision criteria — proceed, revise, defer, kill — that govern how validation evidence translates into action, without pre-determining the outcome.

nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: decision criteria not pre-defined across all four outcome categories. Support: completed criteria register applied transparently to accumulated evidence. nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not select or weight criteria after observing evidence to produce a predetermined outcome.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if validation design, behavioural thresholds, or commercial thresholds change.

nodes.purpose: Define the overall decision criteria framework governing how validation evidence maps to proceed, revise, defer, or kill outcomes.

nodes.required_output: Defer criteria register: criterion, triggering evidence gap, additional evidence required, deferral time-box, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.10.1–BP.10.3 evidence requirements, controller governance rules; evidence_tier_required: E1 for criteria definition; sufficiency_threshold: defer criteria specify the exact evidence gap and a time-boxed condition for re-review; evidence_rationale: defer criteria prevent indefinite ambiguity by requiring an explicit re-review trigger; cannot_support: a defer determination from criteria definition alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: defer criteria not time-boxed or evidence-gap-specific. Support: criteria register reviewed and locked before evidence assessment. Revise: if evidence requirements or governance timelines change. Invalidate: defer criteria cannot be made time-bound.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not use deferral as an indefinite avoidance of a kill or proceed decision.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if evidence requirements, controller governance rules, or deferral timelines change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Criteria definition only; application occurs during decision review.

nodes.purpose: Define the specific, quantified criteria under which the validated hypothesis, pilot, or business model component should be abandoned.
nodes.required_output: Kill criteria register: criterion, triggering evidence pattern, scope of abandonment, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.10.1–BP.10.3 evidence requirements, controller governance rules; evidence_tier_required: E1 for criteria definition; sufficiency_threshold: kill criteria are quantified, evidence-linked, and pre-registered prior to evidence collection; evidence_rationale: pre-registered kill criteria prevent motivated avoidance of negative conclusions; cannot_support: a kill determination from criteria definition alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: kill criteria not quantified and locked. Support: criteria register reviewed and locked before evidence assessment. Revise: if evidence requirements or hypothesis scope changes. Invalidate: no defensible kill criteria can be set.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not raise kill criteria after observing negative evidence to avoid a kill decision.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if hypothesis scope, evidence requirements, or controller governance rules change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Criteria definition only; application occurs during decision review.

nodes.purpose: Identify upstream conditions and architectural dependencies that must be satisfied before the validation decision can be made.
nodes.required_output: Validation decision dependency map: dependency type, prerequisite condition, dependency owner, evidence required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: assumption evidence is required because the PMF evidence path depends on untested behavioural, workflow, buyer, and institutional assumptions that must remain explicit until pilot or commercial evidence exists.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: decision dependency map not completed. Support: cross-branch dependency review. Revise: if upstream architecture changes. Invalidate: blocking dependencies found.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim decision dependencies resolved without upstream confirmation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if validation strategy, behavioural evidence, or PMF evidence architecture changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Dependency mapping only.

nodes.purpose: Define evidence type, tier, source family, and sufficiency threshold required before any validation decision (proceed/revise/defer/kill) can be made.
nodes.required_output: Decision evidence requirements matrix: evidence tier per decision category, permitted sources, sufficiency thresholds, escalation routes.
nodes.evidence_requirement: behavioural, pilot, and where relevant commercial evidence requirements are needed because PMF claims cannot be supported by product architecture, discovery signals, pilot design, or stated interest alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: decision evidence requirements not defined. Support: Evidence Ladder applied per decision category. Revise: if Ladder thresholds change. Invalidate: requirements conflict with BP.3.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — decision evidence requirement gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not make a proceed, revise, defer, or kill decision from below-tier evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder or governance standards change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Defines proof burden only.

nodes.purpose: Define all conclusions that decision threshold architecture must never support, regardless of evidence quantity.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited decision inference register: prohibited conclusion, protected decision component, escalation trigger.
nodes.evidence_requirement: governance-rule evidence is required because this node prevents pilot design, positive feedback, usage intent, pain signals, or early engagement from being misused as PMF, commercial traction, procurement readiness, or repeat-use validation.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated. Support: completed prohibition matrix. Revise: if new prohibited patterns emerge. Invalidate: prohibitions are contradictory.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not retroactively adjust any decision criterion to fit an already-favoured outcome.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new prohibited patterns emerge or narrative implies prohibited decision inferences.
nodes.notes_limitations: Prohibitions are absolute; criteria must be locked before evidence assessment.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.10.4 is internally coherent, complete, and free of prohibited inferences before learning logic and reopen rules proceed.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: decision criteria framework, proceed/revise/defer/kill criteria, dependencies, evidence requirements, and prohibited inferences present, coherent, and non-contradictory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10.4 child nodes, architecture audit, and controller review are required because this node accepts PMF evidence-path architecture only, not PMF itself, market validation, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller approval not recorded. Support: completed architecture review. Revise: if any BP.10.4 child changes. Invalidate: if criteria categories overlap or contradict.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat decision threshold acceptance as a validation outcome.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.10.4 child changes or upstream evidence architecture changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only gate; decision criteria are locked, not yet applied.

nodes.purpose: Defines how new evidence updates prior conclusions and the rules governing when closed nodes must be reopened.
nodes.required_output: Learning framework; evidence update rule register; reopen criteria register; escalation rule register; learning logic acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, controller governance rules, BP.12 risk register; evidence_tier_required: E1 for learning architecture; sufficiency_threshold: learning rules are explicit, apply symmetrically to favourable and unfavourable evidence, and trigger reopening without requiring re-litigation of unrelated nodes; evidence_rationale: learning logic ensures the architecture remains responsive to new evidence rather than static; cannot_support: validation success, PMF, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: learning framework and reopen criteria not populated. Support: completed learning rule register applied consistently. Revise: if governance rules or BP.12 routing logic changes. Invalidate: learning rules are applied asymmetrically or selectively.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not apply update rules selectively to favour predetermined conclusions. Must not ignore reopen triggers once met.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if governance rules, evidence update logic, or BP.12 routing changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Learning logic governs the whole BP architecture's responsiveness to new evidence, not just BP.10.

nodes.purpose: Define the overall framework by which new evidence is incorporated into the architecture, including update frequency and review triggers.
nodes.required_output: Learning framework: update trigger type, review frequency, responsible reviewer, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, controller governance rules; evidence_tier_required: E1 for framework definition; sufficiency_threshold: framework defines how and when new evidence triggers architecture updates, applied symmetrically; evidence_rationale: framework prevents ad hoc or selective incorporation of new evidence; cannot_support: validation success or PMF from framework definition alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: learning framework not defined with explicit triggers. Support: framework reviewed and approved by controller. Revise: if governance rules or review cadence changes. Invalidate: framework permits selective evidence incorporation.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not incorporate new evidence selectively to support a predetermined conclusion.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if governance rules, review cadence, or escalation routes change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Framework definition only.

nodes.purpose: Define the specific rules governing how new evidence updates, strengthens, weakens, or supersedes prior conclusions across the architecture.
nodes.required_output: Evidence update rule register: rule, applicable node type, update trigger, update mechanism, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Evidence Ladder, Architecture Governance Rules, BP.10.5.1 learning framework; evidence_tier_required: E1 for rule definition; sufficiency_threshold: update rules apply symmetrically regardless of whether new evidence is favourable or unfavourable; evidence_rationale: symmetric update rules prevent motivated reasoning in evidence incorporation; cannot_support: validation success or PMF from rule definition alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: evidence update rules not defined symmetrically. Support: rule register reviewed and approved by controller. Revise: if Evidence Ladder or governance rules change. Invalidate: rules are applied asymmetrically.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not apply more scrutiny to unfavourable evidence than favourable evidence, or vice versa.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder or governance rules change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Rule definition only; application occurs as new evidence arrives.

nodes.purpose: Define the specific criteria under which a previously closed or accepted BP node must be reopened for review.
nodes.required_output: Reopen criteria register: criterion, applicable node type, triggering condition, reopen authority, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, BP.10.5.2 update rules, each BP branch's own reopen_condition field; evidence_tier_required: E1 for criteria definition; sufficiency_threshold: reopen criteria are explicit, node-type-specific, and consistently applied; evidence_rationale: reopen criteria ensure the architecture remains current as facts change; cannot_support: validation success or PMF from criteria definition alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: reopen criteria not defined or inconsistently applied across branches. Support: criteria register reviewed against each branch's reopen_condition field. Revise: if governance rules or branch-level reopen conditions change. Invalidate: reopen criteria conflict with branch-specific conditions.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not ignore a met reopen criterion because reopening is inconvenient.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if governance rules or branch-level reopen conditions change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Criteria definition only; triggers apply across the full BP architecture.

nodes.purpose: Define the rules governing when an issue, contradiction, or unresolved gap must be escalated to the controller or BP.12 risk register.
nodes.required_output: Escalation rule register: trigger condition, escalation route, escalation authority, response time-box, and evidence tier required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: Architecture Governance Rules, BP.12 risk register, controller governance rules; evidence_tier_required: E1 for rule definition; sufficiency_threshold: escalation rules specify trigger, route, and authority without permitting silent suppression of escalation-worthy issues; evidence_rationale: escalation rules ensure unresolved risks reach appropriate review rather than being absorbed informally; cannot_support: validation success or PMF from rule definition alone.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: escalation rules not defined or inconsistently routed. Support: rule register reviewed and approved by controller. Revise: if BP.12 routing or governance rules change. Invalidate: escalation-worthy issues are not reaching the controller or BP.12.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not suppress or delay escalation of an issue that meets escalation criteria.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.12 routing logic or controller governance rules change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Rule definition only; escalation occurs as triggering conditions arise.

nodes.purpose: State all unvalidated assumptions underpinning the learning logic and reopen rules with explicit falsification conditions.
nodes.required_output: Learning assumption register: assumption, learning component supported, labelled unvalidated, falsification condition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: assumption evidence is required because validation thresholds depend on untested assumptions about signal strength, failure conditions, acceptable risk, and decision consequences that must be explicit before use.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: learning assumption register not formalised. Support: assumption ledger with falsification conditions. Revise: if governance practice reveals different needs. Invalidate: assumptions are non-falsifiable.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat learning assumption completeness as learning logic validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if governance practice, update rules, or reopen criteria change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption governance only.

nodes.purpose: Identify upstream conditions and architectural dependencies that must be satisfied before learning logic can be applied consistently.
nodes.required_output: Learning dependency map: dependency type, prerequisite condition, dependency owner, evidence required.
nodes.evidence_requirement: decision-threshold evidence is required because proceed, revise, defer, escalate, or kill-condition logic must be specified before evidence is interpreted, but threshold definition does not determine the outcome.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: learning dependency map not completed. Support: cross-branch dependency review. Revise: if upstream governance architecture changes. Invalidate: circular or unresolvable dependencies found.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim learning dependencies resolved without governance confirmation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if governance rules or BP.12 routing architecture changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Dependency mapping only.

nodes.purpose: Define evidence type, tier, source family, and sufficiency threshold required before strengthening any learning logic or reopen claim.
nodes.required_output: Learning evidence requirements matrix: evidence tier per learning claim type, permitted sources, sufficiency thresholds.
nodes.evidence_requirement: Evidence Ladder and validation-plan evidence are required because this node defines what evidence would be needed for a decision gate, not whether the evidence is already sufficient for decision.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: learning evidence requirements not defined. Support: Evidence Ladder applied per learning claim type. Revise: if Ladder thresholds change. Invalidate: requirements conflict with BP.3.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — learning evidence requirement gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat evidence requirements as learning logic validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Evidence Ladder or governance standards change.
nodes.notes_limitations: Defines proof burden only.

nodes.purpose: Define all conclusions that learning logic and reopen-rule architecture must never support, regardless of evidence quantity.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited learning inference register: prohibited conclusion, protected learning component, escalation trigger.
nodes.evidence_requirement: governance-rule evidence is required because this node prevents decision thresholds from being used to imply validation success, PMF, investor readiness, technical feasibility, legal compliance, or commercial readiness before evidence is reviewed.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: prohibition register not populated. Support: completed prohibition matrix. Revise: if new prohibited patterns emerge. Invalidate: prohibitions are contradictory.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat asymmetric application of evidence update rules as legitimate learning. Must not suppress a reopen trigger to preserve a prior conclusion.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new prohibited patterns emerge or narrative implies prohibited learning inferences.
nodes.notes_limitations: Prohibitions are absolute; learning logic must apply symmetrically.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.10.5 is internally coherent, complete, and free of prohibited inferences before the BP.10 validation decision gate proceeds.
nodes.required_output: Acceptance checklist: learning framework, update rules, reopen criteria, escalation rules, assumptions, dependencies, evidence requirements, and prohibited inferences present, coherent, and non-contradictory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10.5 child nodes, architecture audit, and controller review are required because this node accepts decision-threshold architecture only, not any validation, PMF, commercial, legal, or technical outcome.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller approval not recorded. Support: completed architecture review. Revise: if any BP.10.5 child changes. Invalidate: if rules are applied asymmetrically or contradictions remain.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat learning logic acceptance as validation success or PMF.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.10.5 child changes or governance practice reveals asymmetric application.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only gate.

nodes.purpose: Determines whether validation strategy, behavioural evidence, PMF evidence, decision thresholds, and learning logic are coherent enough to support a formal validation decision.
nodes.required_output: BP.10 acceptance checklist; unresolved validation gaps; contradiction register; BP.12 links; branch acceptance decision.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10 child sections, architecture audit, and controller review are required because this node governs branch-level validation architecture coherence only, not validated PMF, diagnostic accuracy, technical feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.10 branch audit not complete. Support: completed audit. Revise: if validation evidence or thresholds conflict. Invalidate: validation path is structurally unsupported.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat architecture coherence as validation success or PMF.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if validation design, behavioural evidence, PMF evidence, decision thresholds, or learning logic changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only gate; validation outcome requires formal controller decision against locked criteria.

nodes.purpose: Verify that all required BP.10 child nodes (BP.10.1–BP.10.5) are present, populated, and not left as empty shells.
nodes.required_output: Completeness audit checklist: each BP.10 section × required-output status × population status × gap flag.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10 child-section evidence is required because this node checks presence and population of validation-architecture components, not the sufficiency, success, or validity of validation evidence.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: completeness audit not conducted. Support: systematic review of BP.10.1–BP.10.5 against required outputs. Revise: if nodes are empty. Invalidate: if required sections are absent.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat node presence as node quality.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.10 section is revised or emptied.
nodes.notes_limitations: Completeness check only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.10.1 for completeness, coherence, and absence of prohibited validation inferences.
nodes.required_output: Validation design audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10.1 evidence is required because this node audits pilot-design coherence and claim discipline, not pilot execution, pilot success, PMF, or product validation.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: validation design audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.10.1.1–BP.10.1.9. Revise: if issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as absence of issues.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.10.1 changes or new design issues are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.10.2 for completeness, measurement coherence, and absence of prohibited behavioural inferences.
nodes.required_output: Behavioural evidence audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10.2 evidence is required because this node audits behavioural-evidence architecture, not validated adoption, repeated use, workflow embedding, PMF, or commercial traction.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: behavioural evidence audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.10.2.1–BP.10.2.9. Revise: if issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as behavioural validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.10.2 changes or new behavioural evidence issues are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.10.3 for completeness, staging coherence, and absence of prohibited PMF inferences.
nodes.required_output: PMF evidence audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10.3 evidence is required because this node audits diagnostic-evaluation architecture, not diagnostic accuracy, reviewer equivalence, publication improvement, or product-effectiveness validation.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: PMF evidence audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.10.3.1–BP.10.3.9. Revise: if issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as PMF attainment.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.10.3 changes or new PMF evidence issues are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Audit BP.10.4 for completeness, criteria-category distinctness, and absence of prohibited decision inferences.
nodes.required_output: Decision threshold audit report: audit scope, items reviewed, issues found, remediation status.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10.4 evidence is required because this node audits PMF evidence-path architecture, not PMF, paid demand, retention, procurement approval, or commercial readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: decision threshold audit not conducted. Support: systematic audit of BP.10.4.1–BP.10.4.9. Revise: if issues found. Invalidate: audit cannot be completed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat audit completion as decision validation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.10.4 changes or new decision-threshold issues are identified.
nodes.notes_limitations: Audit report only.

nodes.purpose: Document all known unvalidated assumptions across BP.10 that remain open, with routing to BP.12.
nodes.required_output: Outstanding assumption register: assumption, affected BP.10 node, assumption type, BP.12 routing, resolution condition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10.5 evidence is required because this node audits decision-threshold and learning-logic architecture, not the outcome of any validation decision.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: outstanding assumption register not compiled. Support: synthesis of assumption registers from BP.10.1–BP.10.5. Revise: if assumptions are resolved or new ones emerge. Invalidate: assumptions are left undocumented.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat assumption documentation as assumption resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new assumptions are identified or existing assumption status changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Assumption register only; does not resolve outstanding assumptions.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that all BP.12-candidate risks and uncertainties identified across BP.10 have been explicitly routed to the BP.12 risk register.
nodes.required_output: BP.12 routing confirmation log: BP.12-candidate item × source BP.10 node × routing status × BP.12 reference.
nodes.evidence_requirement: linked_uncertainties fields and BP.12 register evidence are required because this node verifies routing of unresolved validation assumptions, risks, evidence gaps, and reopen triggers, not their resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.12 routing not confirmed. Support: systematic review of BP.10 linked_uncertainties. Revise: if new BP.12 candidates emerge. Invalidate: candidates are unrouted.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat BP.12 routing as risk resolution.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if new BP.12 candidates are identified or routing status changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Routing confirmation only.

nodes.purpose: Record the controller review and formal acceptance decision for BP.10 validation architecture, without pre-assigning a PMF or commercial outcome.
nodes.required_output: Controller review record and acceptance decision: reviewer, review date, items reviewed, issues raised, decision outcome, conditions, and controller sign-off.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed audit nodes and controller review are required because this node records validation-architecture acceptance or revision routing, not PMF, diagnostic accuracy, technical feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller review not conducted. Support: completed review record with formal decision. Revise: if conditions change. Invalidate: blocking issues remain unresolved without deferral.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat controller review as PMF attainment or commercial readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.10.6 review item changes or new blocking issues are raised.
nodes.notes_limitations: Review and decision record only.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that BP.10 as a whole is architecturally coherent, gap-documented, and sufficiently governed to support a formal validation, PMF, or commercial-readiness determination downstream.
nodes.required_output: BP.10 branch acceptance checklist: completeness, validation design audit, behavioural evidence audit, PMF evidence audit, decision threshold audit, outstanding assumptions, BP.12 routing, controller review, and acceptance decision all satisfactory.
nodes.evidence_requirement: completed BP.10 child nodes, audit evidence, and controller review are required because this node accepts BP.10 as coherent validation and decision-logic architecture only, not validated PMF, diagnostic accuracy, commercial traction, procurement readiness, technical feasibility, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: branch audit not completed. Support: all BP.10.6 checks satisfactory. Revise: child nodes conflict. Invalidate: open contradictions remain without deferral.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat BP.10 branch acceptance as validation success, PMF, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.10 child changes, new evidence contradicts validation architecture, or downstream commercial planning requires architectural revision.
nodes.notes_limitations: Architecture-only branch acceptance gate; PMF and commercial readiness require formal, evidence-backed controller determination.

nodes.node_title: Investor Narrative, Business Plan, and Data Room Readiness
nodes.purpose: Governs evidence-consistent narrative construction, executive business-plan synthesis, claim clearance, unknowns disclosure, data-room readiness, and stakeholder communication packages, without permitting any claim that exceeds the evidence tier already established in BP.1–BP.10.
nodes.required_output: BP.11 node set covering narrative architecture, business plan synthesis, claim clearance and unknowns disclosure, data room readiness, stakeholder communication packages, and the BP.11 communication readiness acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1–BP.10 governed architecture, controller-approved evidence register; evidence_tier_required: E1 for BP.11 communication architecture; claims referenced from BP.1–BP.10 carry their original evidence tier and are not upgraded by inclusion in BP.11; sufficiency_threshold: BP.11.1–BP.11.6 are present, coherent, and every narrative or communication claim is traceable to a specific BP.1–BP.10 node and evidence tier; evidence_rationale: BP.11 is a packaging and disclosure layer; it may compress, summarise, or sequence governed claims for external audiences but may not generate new evidentiary status for any claim; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, investor commitment, narrative persuasiveness, narrative acceptance, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness, or business validity.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no controller-approved narrative or data-room artifact yet exists. Support: controller-signed business plan, pitch narrative, or data room export referencing BP.1–BP.10 node IDs. Revise: underlying BP.1–BP.10 evidence tiers change. Invalidate: a communication artifact asserts a claim with no traceable BP.1–BP.10 source or exceeds the originating node's evidence tier.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — narrative-evidence-drift risk; BP.12 candidate — data-room-incompleteness risk; BP.12 candidate — stakeholder-overclaim risk
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat narrative coherence, synthesis quality, or communication polish as evidence of business validity, investor acceptance, market demand, or commercial readiness. Must not allow BP.11 packaging to upgrade the evidence tier of any underlying BP.1–BP.10 claim.
nodes.dependencies: BP.1; BP.2; BP.3; BP.4; BP.5; BP.6; BP.7; BP.8; BP.9; BP.10
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.1–BP.10 domain changes evidence tier, scope, or status, or if a controller-approved communication artifact is found to contain an untraceable claim.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.11 is a packaging and disclosure layer over BP.1–BP.10; it carries no independent evidentiary weight and must be reopened whenever upstream architecture changes.

nodes.purpose: Defines the strategic narrative EpistemicOS may present to external audiences, and constrains every narrative claim to a traceable BP.1–BP.10 evidence source.
nodes.required_output: Narrative architecture packet covering narrative objectives, core structure, claim inventory, evidence-to-claim mapping, narrative assumptions, dependencies, evidence requirements, prohibited inferences, and the narrative acceptance check.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1–BP.10 governed architecture, controller-approved evidence register; evidence_tier_required: E1 for narrative architecture; claims referenced from BP.1–BP.10 carry their original evidence tier and are not upgraded by inclusion in BP.11; sufficiency_threshold: BP.11.1.1–BP.11.1.9 are present, coherent, and traceable to BP.1–BP.10 source nodes; evidence_rationale: narrative architecture packages governed evidence for external use and cannot itself create new evidentiary status; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, investor commitment, narrative persuasiveness, narrative acceptance, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness, or narrative persuasiveness or investor reaction.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: narrative architecture not yet finalised or controller-reviewed. Support: completed BP.11.1.1–BP.11.1.9 packet with controller sign-off. Revise: underlying BP.1–BP.10 architecture or evidence tiers change. Invalidate: any node within BP.11.1 asserts a claim with no traceable BP.1–BP.10 source.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer business validity, investor acceptance, market demand, or commercial readiness from the completeness of narrative architecture alone.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any node within BP.11.1 changes, if its BP.1–BP.10 source content changes, or if controller review identifies an untraceable or misclassified claim.
nodes.notes_limitations: Evidence-Consistent Narrative Architecture governs packaging and disclosure only; it cannot upgrade the evidence tier of any BP.1–BP.10 source claim.

nodes.purpose: Define what the evidence-consistent narrative must achieve — orienting external audiences toward the governed product, problem, and evidence state — without implying that the narrative will be found persuasive or compelling.
nodes.required_output: Narrative objectives statement: orient audience to product identity, problem framing, governed evidence state, and roadmap, bounded by what BP.1–BP.10 actually support.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1–BP.10 governed architecture, controller-approved evidence register; evidence_tier_required: E1 for narrative architecture; claims referenced from BP.1–BP.10 carry their original evidence tier and are not upgraded by inclusion in BP.11; sufficiency_threshold: narrative objectives is clearly defined, internally coherent, and does not exceed the evidence tier of its BP.1–BP.10 source node(s); evidence_rationale: narrative objectives governs how narrative content may be used externally and cannot itself upgrade source evidence; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, investor commitment, narrative persuasiveness, narrative acceptance, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: narrative objectives not yet documented or controller-reviewed. Support: completed, dated narrative objectives artifact referencing source BP node(s). Revise: source BP.1–BP.10 architecture or evidence tiers change. Invalidate: narrative objectives cannot be traced to a governed BP.1–BP.10 source.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — narrative objectives gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not claim the narrative will persuade, convert, or secure investor commitment, or that narrative objectives equate to narrative success.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if narrative objectives content changes, if its underlying BP.1–BP.10 source changes, or if controller review finds a traceability gap.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1–BP.10 governed architecture, controller-approved evidence register; evidence_tier_required: E1 for acceptance review architecture; claims referenced from BP.1–BP.10 carry their original evidence tier and are not upgraded by inclusion in BP.11; sufficiency_threshold: stakeholder communication audit is clearly defined, internally coherent, and does not exceed the evidence tier of its BP.1–BP.10 source node(s); evidence_rationale: stakeholder communication audit governs how acceptance review content may be used externally and cannot itself upgrade source evidence; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, investor commitment, narrative persuasiveness, narrative acceptance, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.

nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — stakeholder communication audit gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not close the stakeholder communication audit while a package grants an audience access to a restricted claim.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if stakeholder communication audit content changes, if its underlying BP.1–BP.10 source changes, or if controller review finds a traceability gap.
nodes.notes_limitations: Stakeholder Communication Audit records a controller-facing review outcome and must be dated and attributable to a named reviewer.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1–BP.10 governed architecture, controller-approved evidence register; evidence_tier_required: E1 for acceptance review architecture; claims referenced from BP.1–BP.10 carry their original evidence tier and are not upgraded by inclusion in BP.11; sufficiency_threshold: bp.12 uncertainty routing review is clearly defined, internally coherent, and does not exceed the evidence tier of its BP.1–BP.10 source node(s); evidence_rationale: bp.12 uncertainty routing review governs how acceptance review content may be used externally and cannot itself upgrade source evidence; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, investor commitment, narrative persuasiveness, narrative acceptance, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.

nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — bp.12 uncertainty routing review gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not leave a BP.11 uncertainty untracked or unrouted to BP.12.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if bp.12 uncertainty routing review content changes, if its underlying BP.1–BP.10 source changes, or if controller review finds a traceability gap.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.12 Uncertainty Routing Review records a controller-facing review outcome and must be dated and attributable to a named reviewer.

nodes.purpose: Record the controller's review and final accept/revise/reject decision for the BP.11 branch.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1–BP.10 governed architecture, controller-approved evidence register; evidence_tier_required: E1 for acceptance review architecture; claims referenced from BP.1–BP.10 carry their original evidence tier and are not upgraded by inclusion in BP.11; sufficiency_threshold: controller review and acceptance decision is clearly defined, internally coherent, and does not exceed the evidence tier of its BP.1–BP.10 source node(s); evidence_rationale: controller review and acceptance decision governs how acceptance review content may be used externally and cannot itself upgrade source evidence; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, investor commitment, narrative persuasiveness, narrative acceptance, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: controller review and acceptance decision not yet documented or controller-reviewed. Support: completed, dated controller review and acceptance decision artifact referencing source BP node(s). Revise: source BP.1–BP.10 architecture or evidence tiers change. Invalidate: controller review and acceptance decision cannot be traced to a governed BP.1–BP.10 source.
nodes.linked_uncertainties: linked_uncertainties: BP.12 candidate — controller review and acceptance decision gap
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat a pending or conditional controller decision as final acceptance.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if controller review and acceptance decision content changes, if its underlying BP.1–BP.10 source changes, or if controller review finds a traceability gap.
nodes.notes_limitations: Controller Review and Acceptance Decision records a controller-facing review outcome and must be dated and attributable to a named reviewer.

nodes.purpose: Confirm that all BP.11.6 nodes are present, internally coherent, and ready for controller review.
nodes.required_output: BP.11 Branch Acceptance Check checklist: node ID + present (Y/N) + coherent (Y/N) + outstanding issue.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: canonical_product_context, BP.1–BP.10 governed architecture, controller-approved evidence register; evidence_tier_required: E1 for acceptance review architecture; claims referenced from BP.1–BP.10 carry their original evidence tier and are not upgraded by inclusion in BP.11; sufficiency_threshold: bp.11 branch acceptance check is clearly defined, internally coherent, and does not exceed the evidence tier of its BP.1–BP.10 source node(s); evidence_rationale: bp.11 branch acceptance check governs how acceptance review content may be used externally and cannot itself upgrade source evidence; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, investor commitment, narrative persuasiveness, narrative acceptance, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: bp.11 branch acceptance check not yet documented or controller-reviewed. Support: completed, dated bp.11 branch acceptance check artifact referencing source BP node(s). Revise: source BP.1–BP.10 architecture or evidence tiers change. Invalidate: bp.11 branch acceptance check cannot be traced to a governed BP.1–BP.10 source.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not mark BP.11.6 as accepted while any required node is missing, contradictory, or unresolved.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if bp.11 branch acceptance check content changes, if its underlying BP.1–BP.10 source changes, or if controller review finds a traceability gap.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.11 Branch Acceptance Check confirms internal completeness only; it does not certify business viability, investor acceptance, or commercial readiness.

nodes.purpose: Govern the single cross-domain register that captures, classifies, and tracks every risk and unresolved uncertainty surfaced by BP.1-BP.11 until it is mitigated, resolved, or explicitly accepted.
nodes.required_output: BP.12 Risk and Uncertainty Register domain architecture.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: linked_uncertainties fields from BP.1-BP.11, internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every BP.12-candidate item from BP.1-BP.11 has a corresponding register entry; evidence_rationale: the register is a governance artifact, not a source of business evidence; cannot_support: demand, adoption, PMF, compliance, feasibility, commercial readiness, or investor readiness.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: register not yet populated from BP.1-BP.11 routing. Support: completed routing confirmation logs from each domain's acceptance check. Revise: new domains or nodes are added upstream. Invalidate: a domain's routing log is found incomplete.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to claim risk resolution, mitigation success, or reduced uncertainty on its own.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen whenever a new BP.12-candidate item is routed in from any domain or an existing entry's status changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: Cross-domain register; owns no independent business evidence.

nodes.purpose: Define the fixed risk-category taxonomy and the register schema used to log every risk and uncertainty consistently.
nodes.required_output: Risk taxonomy definition and register schema specification.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: taxonomy covers all risk categories referenced across BP.1-BP.11; evidence_rationale: a shared taxonomy is required before intake can be consistent; cannot_support: risk severity, likelihood, or resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: taxonomy not yet ratified. Support: cross-domain review confirming no risk category is left unclassifiable. Revise: a new risk category is identified. Invalidate: categories overlap or leave items unclassifiable.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to imply any risk is resolved or reduced.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a routed item does not fit any existing category.
nodes.notes_limitations: Structural section; governs BP.12.1.1-9.

nodes.purpose: Define the closed list of risk categories the register recognises.
nodes.required_output: Risk category taxonomy: product, technical, legal, adoption, procurement, data-access, validation, credibility, funding, founder/team.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every category is mutually distinguishable and every BP domain maps to at least one category; evidence_rationale: taxonomy is a governance definition, not empirical evidence; cannot_support: risk severity or likelihood.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: category boundaries untested against real routed items. Support: successful classification of a full routing pass with no leftover items. Revise: a routed item spans two categories cleanly. Invalidate: two categories cannot be distinguished in practice.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not imply completeness of actual risks, only completeness of category definitions.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a new risk type cannot be classified under the existing taxonomy.
nodes.notes_limitations: Ten fixed categories; closed list, extensible only via controller approval.

nodes.purpose: Define the field set every register entry must carry.
nodes.required_output: Register schema: risk_id, category, title, description, source_node, severity, likelihood, status, owner, trigger, mitigation_plan, review_date.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: schema fields are sufficient to reconstruct any risk's status without external context; evidence_rationale: schema is a structural definition; cannot_support: risk content itself.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: schema not yet tested against a populated register. Support: a full register pass using only these fields with no missing information. Revise: a required field proves insufficient. Invalidate: entries cannot be tracked to resolution using the schema.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be treated as evidence about any specific risk.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if population of the register reveals a missing field.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define how each register entry is uniquely identified and named.
nodes.required_output: Risk ID convention: R-[BP source domain].[sequence], e.g. R-BP.6.014.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every risk ID is unique and traceable to its routing source node; evidence_rationale: identifiers are structural, not evidentiary; cannot_support: risk content.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none once adopted. Support: no ID collisions across a full register population. Revise: source-domain prefix scheme changes. Invalidate: two distinct risks share an ID.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to infer risk priority from ID sequence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ID collisions occur.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define the fixed scales used to score risk severity and likelihood.
nodes.required_output: Severity scale (low/medium/high/critical) and likelihood scale (unlikely/possible/likely/near-certain) with explicit criteria for each level.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: each scale level has a distinguishing, non-overlapping criterion; evidence_rationale: scales are governance instruments, not measurements of actual outcomes; cannot_support: that any specific risk has been resolved or reduced.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: scale criteria not yet stress-tested against ambiguous cases. Support: consistent scoring by two independent reviewers on the same item. Revise: reviewers disagree on borderline cases in a way that reveals ambiguity. Invalidate: scale levels cannot be applied consistently.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not imply that a severity or likelihood score is itself validated business evidence.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if scoring proves inconsistent across reviewers.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State the assumptions underlying the taxonomy and schema.
nodes.required_output: Assumption register for BP.12.1: fixed taxonomy is exhaustive at current architecture maturity; ten categories will not require expansion before Level 5 decomposition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: assumptions are explicit and individually falsifiable; evidence_rationale: assumptions must be visible to be tested; cannot_support: that the assumptions are currently true.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: assumptions untested against a fully populated register. Support: a full routing pass that does not require a new category. Revise: a routed item forces a taxonomy exception. Invalidate: category exhaustiveness fails repeatedly.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be treated as confirmed fact.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any assumption is falsified.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State what BP.12.1 depends on and what depends on it.
nodes.required_output: Dependency map: BP.12.1 depends on nothing upstream; BP.12.2-BP.12.5 all depend on BP.12.1's taxonomy and schema being ratified.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: dependency map is bidirectionally consistent with all downstream BP.12 sections; evidence_rationale: structural mapping only; cannot_support: risk content.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none once ratified. Support: downstream sections build without schema exceptions. Revise: a downstream section requires a schema change. Invalidate: circular dependency is found.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to infer risk status.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a downstream section requires a structural change here.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State the evidence standard for accepting the taxonomy and schema as architecturally sound.
nodes.required_output: Evidence requirement specification for BP.12.1 acceptance.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: at least one full test routing pass completed with zero unclassifiable items; evidence_rationale: structural soundness is demonstrated by successful use, not by declaration; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no test pass has yet been run. Support: a successful test pass. Revise: partial failures found. Invalidate: repeated unclassifiable items.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used as evidence of risk mitigation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a later routing pass fails classification.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State inferences the taxonomy and schema must never be used to support.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited inference list for BP.12.1.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: prohibited list explicitly excludes risk-resolution and validation-success claims; evidence_rationale: guards against structural artifacts being read as business evidence; cannot_support: any business claim.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer that having a taxonomy means all risks are identified, or that any given category being 'low count' means low actual risk.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a prohibited inference is observed in practice.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Confirm the taxonomy and schema are ready for use before intake begins.
nodes.required_output: BP.12.1 acceptance decision record.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.1.1-BP.12.1.8; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all BP.12.1 subnodes are architecture_status candidate or better with no open gaps; evidence_rationale: gate confirms structural readiness only; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: pending first controller review.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be self-assigned accepted.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.12.1 subnode is revised.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Govern how BP.12-candidate items surfaced in BP.1-BP.11 linked_uncertainties fields and acceptance checks are received into the register.
nodes.required_output: Intake and routing protocol specification.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.1-BP.11 linked_uncertainties fields and acceptance-check routing rows; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every domain's BP.12 Uncertainty Routing Review subnode has a defined intake path into this section; evidence_rationale: intake is a structural handoff; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: intake not yet exercised end-to-end for any domain. Support: at least one domain's routing log fully absorbed into the register. Revise: a domain's routing format changes. Invalidate: routed items cannot be matched to register entries.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not imply that routing an item resolves or reduces it.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a domain's routing output cannot be ingested.
nodes.notes_limitations: Governs BP.12.2.1-9.

nodes.purpose: Define which upstream fields and nodes feed the register.
nodes.required_output: Intake source list: linked_uncertainties field of every BP.1-BP.11 atomic node, plus each domain's 'BP.12 Uncertainty Routing Review' acceptance-check subnode.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.1-BP.11 architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every domain has at least one confirmed intake source; evidence_rationale: structural mapping; cannot_support: risk content.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: BP.9 and BP.7 intake sources not yet cross-checked. Support: a full source inventory matching each domain's routing subnode. Revise: a domain adds new uncertainty-bearing nodes. Invalidate: a domain has no mapped intake source.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to infer risk completeness of any single domain.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a domain's intake source changes.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define the step-by-step process by which a BP.12-candidate item becomes a register entry.
nodes.required_output: Routing protocol: identify candidate in source node -> confirm via domain's acceptance check -> assign risk ID -> log in register with status 'open' -> notify owner.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: protocol produces one and only one register entry per candidate item; evidence_rationale: process definition, not empirical evidence; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: protocol not yet run against a full domain. Support: a clean run producing no duplicate or orphaned entries. Revise: duplicates or orphans appear. Invalidate: protocol cannot process a domain's routing log.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to claim risks are being actively mitigated.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if duplicate or orphaned entries are found.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define the format used to record that a domain's routing has been completed and confirmed.
nodes.required_output: Routing confirmation log: domain x candidate item x routing status x register reference x confirmation date.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: log format matches the structure already used in each domain's BP.12 Uncertainty Routing Review subnode; evidence_rationale: format alignment prevents information loss at handoff; cannot_support: risk content.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: format not yet cross-validated against all 11 domains' routing rows. Support: successful format match for a sample of domains. Revise: a domain's routing row uses an incompatible format. Invalidate: log cannot represent a domain's routing output.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be treated as evidence the underlying risk is closed.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a domain's format proves incompatible.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define when a candidate item may be logged as deferred rather than immediately actioned.
nodes.required_output: Deferral criteria: item has no current owner available, item's trigger condition has not yet occurred, or item is explicitly out of scope for the current architecture stage, each requiring controller sign-off.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: deferral criteria are exhaustive and mutually exclusive with 'open' and 'closed' statuses; evidence_rationale: deferral is a governance decision, not evidence of reduced risk; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: criteria untested against a real deferred item. Support: a deferred item later reactivated correctly on trigger. Revise: a deferral case does not fit existing criteria. Invalidate: deferral is used to permanently hide a risk.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to close out a risk without controller sign-off.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if deferral is used inconsistently.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State the assumptions underlying the intake and routing process.
nodes.required_output: Assumption register for BP.12.2: every domain's acceptance-check layer reliably surfaces its own BP.12-candidate items before the branch is marked accepted.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: assumptions are explicit and falsifiable; evidence_rationale: assumptions must be visible to be tested; cannot_support: that the assumptions are currently true.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: assumption untested at scale. Support: a domain's full acceptance pass identifies all its actual uncertainties. Revise: a domain later reveals an uncertainty missed at acceptance. Invalidate: pattern of missed uncertainties across multiple domains.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be treated as confirmed fact.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any assumption is falsified.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State what BP.12.2 depends on and what depends on it.
nodes.required_output: Dependency map: BP.12.2 depends on BP.12.1 schema and taxonomy and on each domain's acceptance-check routing subnode; BP.12.3-BP.12.5 depend on BP.12.2 producing valid entries.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: dependency map is bidirectionally consistent; evidence_rationale: structural mapping only; cannot_support: risk content.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none once ratified.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to infer risk status.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a downstream section requires a structural change here.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State the evidence standard for accepting the intake and routing process as functioning correctly.
nodes.required_output: Evidence requirement specification for BP.12.2 acceptance.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: routing confirmation logs from at least two domains; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: two independent domains' routing logs are fully absorbed with zero orphaned or duplicated entries; evidence_rationale: correctness is demonstrated by successful dual-domain use; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no domain routing log has yet been processed. Support: successful dual-domain test. Revise: partial failures found. Invalidate: repeated orphaned or duplicate entries.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used as evidence of risk mitigation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a later routing pass fails.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State inferences the intake and routing process must never be used to support.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited inference list for BP.12.2.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: list explicitly excludes risk-resolution claims; evidence_rationale: guards against process artifacts being read as business evidence; cannot_support: any business claim.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer that routing an item into the register reduces, mitigates, or resolves the underlying risk.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a prohibited inference is observed in practice.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Confirm the intake and routing process is ready for full-scale use across all eleven domains.
nodes.required_output: BP.12.2 acceptance decision record.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.2.1-BP.12.2.8; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all BP.12.2 subnodes are architecture_status candidate or better with no open gaps; evidence_rationale: gate confirms process readiness only; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: pending first controller review.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be self-assigned accepted.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.12.2 subnode is revised.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Govern how each register entry is classified by category and scored for severity and likelihood.
nodes.required_output: Risk classification and scoring specification.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.1 taxonomy and scales, populated register entries; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every open register entry has a category, severity, and likelihood score; evidence_rationale: classification is a governance judgment, not business evidence; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: scoring not yet exercised on a populated register. Support: a full scoring pass with no unscored entries. Revise: scoring criteria prove ambiguous in practice. Invalidate: scores cannot be applied consistently.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not imply that a scored risk is thereby mitigated.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if scoring criteria are revised.
nodes.notes_limitations: Governs BP.12.3.1-9.

nodes.purpose: Assign each register entry to one of the ten fixed risk categories.
nodes.required_output: Classified register: risk_id x category.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.1.1 taxonomy; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every open entry has exactly one primary category; evidence_rationale: classification is structural, not empirical; cannot_support: risk severity.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: multi-category items not yet resolved to a single primary category. Support: a classification pass with no unresolved multi-category items. Revise: an item genuinely spans two categories. Invalidate: an item cannot be classified at all.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to infer risk severity from category alone.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a new entry cannot be classified.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Apply the fixed severity scale to each register entry.
nodes.required_output: Scored register: risk_id x severity (low/medium/high/critical) x rationale.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.1.4 severity scale; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every open entry has a severity score with a one-sentence rationale; evidence_rationale: scoring is a governance judgment; cannot_support: that the underlying business risk is quantified with certainty.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: scoring rationale not yet peer-reviewed. Support: two independent scorers reach the same severity level. Revise: scorers disagree in a way that reveals scale ambiguity. Invalidate: scoring cannot be reproduced.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be presented as a quantified financial or probabilistic estimate.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if reviewers disagree on a scored entry.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Apply the fixed likelihood scale to each register entry.
nodes.required_output: Scored register: risk_id x likelihood (unlikely/possible/likely/near-certain) x rationale.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.1.4 likelihood scale; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every open entry has a likelihood score with a one-sentence rationale; evidence_rationale: scoring is a governance judgment; cannot_support: precise probability estimates.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: likelihood rationale not yet peer-reviewed. Support: two independent scorers reach the same likelihood level. Revise: scorers disagree in a way that reveals scale ambiguity. Invalidate: scoring cannot be reproduced.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be presented as a statistically derived probability.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if reviewers disagree on a scored entry.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define how severity and likelihood combine into a single priority ranking.
nodes.required_output: Composite risk score matrix: severity x likelihood -> priority tier (monitor/manage/urgent/critical).
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.3.2; BP.12.3.3; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every combination of severity and likelihood maps to exactly one priority tier; evidence_rationale: the matrix is a governance ranking tool; cannot_support: that priority tier equals actual business impact.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: matrix not yet validated against a populated register. Support: priority ranking matches controller's independent judgment on a sample. Revise: controller disagrees with matrix-derived priority on a sample. Invalidate: matrix produces rankings controller consistently overrides.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used as the sole basis for a go/no-go product decision.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if controller consistently overrides matrix output.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State the assumptions underlying classification and scoring.
nodes.required_output: Assumption register for BP.12.3: category, severity, and likelihood remain stable between review cycles unless a trigger event occurs.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: assumptions are explicit and falsifiable; evidence_rationale: assumptions must be visible to be tested; cannot_support: that the assumptions are currently true.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: stability untested across multiple review cycles. Support: scores unchanged across two consecutive reviews absent a trigger. Revise: a score drifts without an identifiable trigger. Invalidate: scores are unstable without cause.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be treated as confirmed fact.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any assumption is falsified.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State what BP.12.3 depends on and what depends on it.
nodes.required_output: Dependency map: BP.12.3 depends on BP.12.1 scales and BP.12.2 populated entries; BP.12.4 mitigation planning depends on BP.12.3 priority tiers.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: dependency map is bidirectionally consistent; evidence_rationale: structural mapping only; cannot_support: risk content.

nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to infer risk status.

nodes.purpose: State the evidence standard for accepting classification and scoring as functioning correctly.
nodes.required_output: Evidence requirement specification for BP.12.3 acceptance.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: a fully scored register sample; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: inter-reviewer agreement on category, severity, and likelihood for a sample of at least five entries; evidence_rationale: reliability is demonstrated by reproducibility; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no inter-reviewer test yet run. Support: successful agreement test. Revise: partial disagreement found. Invalidate: repeated disagreement without resolution.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used as evidence of risk mitigation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a later reliability test fails.
