nodes.purpose: State inferences classification and scoring must never be used to support.

nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer that a 'low' severity score means the underlying risk requires no monitoring, or that scoring itself reduces risk.

nodes.purpose: Confirm classification and scoring are ready for use in mitigation prioritisation.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.3.1-BP.12.3.8; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all BP.12.3 subnodes are architecture_status candidate or better with no open gaps; evidence_rationale: gate confirms scoring readiness only; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: pending first controller review.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be self-assigned accepted.

nodes.purpose: Govern how each register entry is assigned an owner, a mitigation plan, and a trigger condition.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.3 classified and scored register entries; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every open entry at 'manage', 'urgent', or 'critical' priority has an assigned owner and a mitigation plan; evidence_rationale: planning is a governance action, not business evidence; cannot_support: that mitigation has succeeded.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: mitigation planning not yet exercised on a populated register. Support: every high-priority entry has an owner and plan. Revise: an owner cannot be identified for a category. Invalidate: entries remain unowned past one review cycle.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not imply mitigation success, only that a plan exists.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if ownership or plans lapse.
nodes.notes_limitations: Governs BP.12.4.1-9.

nodes.purpose: Require a documented mitigation plan for every entry above 'monitor' priority tier.
nodes.required_output: Mitigation plan register: risk_id x plan description x expected outcome x target date.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.3.4 priority tiers; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every 'manage', 'urgent', or 'critical' entry has a non-empty mitigation plan; evidence_rationale: plan existence is a governance fact; cannot_support: that the plan will succeed.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: plans not yet drafted for the initial register population. Support: a full pass with no missing plans above threshold. Revise: a plan proves infeasible. Invalidate: plans remain absent past one review cycle.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be presented as evidence the risk has already been reduced.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a plan is missing at review.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Assign a single accountable owner to every open register entry.
nodes.required_output: Ownership register: risk_id x owner x assignment date.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture, organisational role map; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every open entry has exactly one named owner; evidence_rationale: ownership is an accountability assignment, not evidence of risk state; cannot_support: mitigation progress.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: owners not yet confirmed for categories without a clear internal role (e.g. founder/team risk). Support: every category has at least one available owner. Revise: an owner leaves or role changes. Invalidate: a category has no available owner.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to imply the owner has already acted on the risk.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if an owner becomes unavailable.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define the observable condition that activates or escalates each register entry.
nodes.required_output: Trigger register: risk_id x trigger condition x detection method.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture, source domain node; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every entry above 'monitor' tier has an observable, detectable trigger condition; evidence_rationale: trigger definitions must be checkable, not speculative; cannot_support: that a trigger has occurred.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: some triggers not yet made observable/detectable. Support: a trigger is detected and correctly escalates the entry. Revise: a trigger proves undetectable in practice. Invalidate: a trigger occurs without detection.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to claim a risk has or has not materialised absent an observed trigger.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a trigger proves undetectable.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define who is notified and what happens when a trigger fires.
nodes.required_output: Escalation path specification: trigger fires -> owner notified -> controller notified if priority is urgent or critical -> review scheduled within a defined window.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: escalation path defines a bounded response window for every priority tier; evidence_rationale: process definition, not empirical evidence; cannot_support: that escalation resolves the risk.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: response window not yet tested against a live trigger. Support: a triggered entry is reviewed within the defined window. Revise: the window proves too short or too long in practice. Invalidate: a triggered entry is not reviewed within the window.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to claim the risk is resolved once escalated.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if an escalation is missed.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State the assumptions underlying mitigation planning and ownership.
nodes.required_output: Assumption register for BP.12.4: every risk category has at least one internal role capable of owning mitigation; mitigation plans do not require external funding at current architecture stage.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: assumptions are explicit and falsifiable; evidence_rationale: assumptions must be visible to be tested; cannot_support: that the assumptions are currently true.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: funding-risk and founder/team-risk ownership assumptions untested. Support: an owner is successfully assigned in every category. Revise: a category requires external support to mitigate. Invalidate: a category has no feasible internal owner.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be treated as confirmed fact.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any assumption is falsified.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State what BP.12.4 depends on and what depends on it.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: dependency map is bidirectionally consistent; evidence_rationale: structural mapping only; cannot_support: risk content.

nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to infer risk status.

nodes.purpose: State the evidence standard for accepting mitigation planning and ownership as functioning correctly.
nodes.required_output: Evidence requirement specification for BP.12.4 acceptance.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: populated ownership and mitigation plan register; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: 100 percent of entries above 'monitor' tier have both an owner and a plan; evidence_rationale: coverage is demonstrated by complete assignment, not declaration; cannot_support: that mitigation has succeeded.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: coverage not yet at 100 percent for the initial population. Support: full coverage achieved and maintained across one review cycle. Revise: coverage drops after new entries are added. Invalidate: coverage cannot reach 100 percent for a category.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used as evidence of risk mitigation success.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if coverage drops below threshold.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State inferences mitigation planning and ownership must never be used to support.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited inference list for BP.12.4.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: list explicitly excludes claims that a plan's existence equals risk reduction; evidence_rationale: guards against governance artifacts being read as business evidence; cannot_support: any business claim.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer that having an owner or plan means the underlying risk has been reduced or eliminated.

nodes.node_title: Risk Monitoring, Review Cadence, and Reopen Logic
nodes.purpose: Govern how the register is kept current: review cadence, status updates, and conditions for reopening closed entries.
nodes.required_output: Monitoring and review cadence specification.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.4 owned and planned register entries; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every open entry is reviewed at least once per defined cadence; evidence_rationale: monitoring is a governance activity; cannot_support: that risk levels have actually decreased.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: cadence not yet exercised over multiple cycles. Support: two consecutive review cycles completed on schedule. Revise: cadence proves too frequent or too sparse for a category. Invalidate: reviews are consistently missed.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not imply that a scheduled review itself reduces risk.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if review cadence is missed twice consecutively.
nodes.notes_limitations: Governs BP.12.5.1-9.

nodes.purpose: Define how often each priority tier is reviewed.
nodes.required_output: Cadence table: critical = weekly, urgent = biweekly, manage = monthly, monitor = quarterly.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.3.4 priority tiers; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every priority tier has a defined, non-overlapping review interval; evidence_rationale: cadence is a governance schedule; cannot_support: risk state.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: cadence not yet stress-tested for founder-capacity constraints. Support: cadence sustained across two full cycles without missed reviews. Revise: capacity constraints require interval adjustment. Invalidate: cadence cannot be sustained at current team size.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to infer actual risk trend.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if cadence cannot be sustained.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define the allowed status values and how an entry moves between them.
nodes.required_output: Status protocol: open -> monitoring -> mitigating -> closed, or open -> deferred, with required justification for every transition.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every status transition has a recorded justification and date; evidence_rationale: status is a governance record, not an outcome measurement; cannot_support: that closure reflects actual risk elimination.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: closure criteria not yet stress-tested. Support: a closed entry does not require reopening within one review cycle. Revise: a closed entry is reopened, revealing premature closure. Invalidate: closure is applied without justification.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not treat 'closed' status as proof the underlying risk cannot recur.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if closure criteria prove too permissive.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define what happens procedurally the moment a defined trigger is detected.
nodes.required_output: Trigger activation log: risk_id x trigger detected date x action taken x escalation record reference.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.4.3 trigger definitions, BP.12.4.4 escalation path; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: every detected trigger has a logged action within the defined escalation window; evidence_rationale: activation handling is procedural; cannot_support: that the action taken was effective.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: no live trigger activation observed yet. Support: a triggered entry is logged and actioned within window. Revise: window proves insufficient for the required action. Invalidate: a detected trigger has no logged action.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to claim the response was successful, only that it occurred.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a detected trigger has no logged response.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Define the conditions under which a closed register entry must be reopened.
nodes.required_output: Reopen criteria: trigger condition recurs, new evidence contradicts closure rationale, or a related BP domain node is itself reopened.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: reopen criteria are exhaustive relative to observed closure-failure modes; evidence_rationale: criteria are a governance rule set; cannot_support: risk state.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: criteria untested against a real reopen case. Support: a reopen case is correctly triggered by one of the defined criteria. Revise: a closed entry recurs without matching any defined criterion. Invalidate: reopen criteria fail to catch a recurrence.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to keep an entry closed when a related upstream BP node has reopened.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a recurrence is missed by existing criteria.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State the assumptions underlying monitoring and review cadence.
nodes.required_output: Assumption register for BP.12.5: current team capacity is sufficient to sustain the defined cadence across all priority tiers simultaneously.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: assumptions are explicit and falsifiable; evidence_rationale: assumptions must be visible to be tested; cannot_support: that the assumptions are currently true.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: capacity assumption untested as register grows. Support: cadence sustained as register scales past initial population. Revise: register growth outpaces review capacity. Invalidate: reviews are systematically missed as register grows.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be treated as confirmed fact.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any assumption is falsified.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State what BP.12.5 depends on and what depends on it.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: dependency map is bidirectionally consistent; evidence_rationale: structural mapping only; cannot_support: risk content.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none once ratified.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to infer risk status.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a downstream section requires a structural change here.

nodes.purpose: State the evidence standard for accepting monitoring and review cadence as functioning correctly.
nodes.required_output: Evidence requirement specification for BP.12.5 acceptance.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: review log across at least two cadence cycles; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: zero missed reviews across two consecutive cycles for critical and urgent tiers; evidence_rationale: reliability demonstrated by sustained on-time reviews; cannot_support: that risk levels have decreased.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: fewer than two cadence cycles completed to date. Support: two cycles completed with zero missed critical/urgent reviews. Revise: a review is missed once. Invalidate: reviews are missed repeatedly.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used as evidence of risk mitigation.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if reviews are missed repeatedly.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: State inferences monitoring and review activity must never be used to support.
nodes.required_output: Prohibited inference list for BP.12.5.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: internal_architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: list explicitly excludes claims that review activity itself reduces risk; evidence_rationale: guards against process artifacts being read as business evidence; cannot_support: any business claim.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not infer that a risk with no status change since last review is therefore low-priority or resolved.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a prohibited inference is observed in practice.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Confirm monitoring, review cadence, and reopen logic are ready for ongoing use.

nodes.purpose: Confirm the entire BP.12 risk and uncertainty register — structure, intake, classification, mitigation, and monitoring — is complete and functioning before it is treated as the system of record.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.1-BP.12.5; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: all five prior sections pass their own acceptance checks and cross-domain routing is confirmed complete; evidence_rationale: this is a structural completeness gate; cannot_support: that any individual risk is resolved.

nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be self-assigned accepted; must not be read as evidence that business risk overall is low.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any upstream domain surfaces a new BP.12-candidate item.
nodes.notes_limitations: Governs BP.12.6.1-9.

nodes.purpose: Confirm every section of BP.12 has been built and no structural element is missing.
nodes.required_output: Completeness checklist: BP.12.1-BP.12.5 all present with all nine subnodes each.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.1-BP.12.5; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: zero missing subnodes across all five sections; evidence_rationale: structural completeness is directly verifiable; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none once verified.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to imply register content is complete, only structure.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a subnode is removed or found missing.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Confirm every BP.1-BP.11 domain's 'BP.12 Uncertainty Routing Review' subnode has a matching set of register entries.
nodes.required_output: Cross-domain routing audit table: domain x expected candidates x register entries found x variance.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.5.6.7, BP.6.7.7, BP.7.6.9, BP.8.9.7, BP.9.6.9, BP.10.6.7, BP.11.6.7, and equivalent routing subnodes across BP.1-BP.4; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: zero-variance match for every domain audited; evidence_rationale: this is the primary cross-domain integrity check for the register; cannot_support: that routed risks are resolved.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: audit not yet run for BP.1-BP.4, which predate BP.12's construction and may not reference it explicitly. Support: a full eleven-domain audit with zero unexplained variance. Revise: a domain is found to reference BP.12 without a matching entry. Invalidate: variance persists after remediation.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to claim any specific risk is closed.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a new domain routing subnode is added or a variance is found.
nodes.notes_limitations: BP.1-BP.4 acceptance-check subnodes were built before BP.12 existed and should be reviewed for an equivalent routing step; flagged here rather than silently assumed complete.

nodes.purpose: Confirm every open register entry has a category, severity score, likelihood score, and priority tier.
nodes.required_output: Classification audit table: risk_id x category present x severity present x likelihood present x priority tier present.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.3; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: 100 percent field completion across all open entries; evidence_rationale: directly verifiable structural check; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: none once verified.

nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen whenever a domain is revised or a new node is added upstream.

nodes.purpose: Confirm the review cadence defined in BP.12.5 is actually being followed.
nodes.required_output: Cadence audit table: priority tier x defined interval x actual review dates x variance.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.5; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: zero missed reviews for critical and urgent tiers across the audited period; evidence_rationale: directly verifiable operational check; cannot_support: that risk levels have decreased.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: fewer than one full cadence cycle completed at time of first audit. Support: audited period shows zero missed critical/urgent reviews. Revise: cadence is adjusted following BP.12.5.1 reopen. Invalidate: missed reviews recur after remediation.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be used to imply reduced risk from consistent review alone.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a review is missed.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Confirm BP.12's own outputs do not contradict or duplicate governance already owned by BP.10 (validation/learning) or any other domain's acceptance-check layer.

nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.10 architecture, BP.12 architecture; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: no BP.12 node duplicates a BP.10 validation/learning function or overrides a domain's own decision gate; evidence_rationale: prevents governance-role duplication across domains; cannot_support: risk resolution.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: not yet cross-checked against BP.10.5 (Learning Logic and Reopen Rules), which has a related but distinct purpose. Support: review confirms no overlap. Revise: an overlap is found and one domain's scope is narrowed. Invalidate: overlap persists after remediation.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not duplicate BP.10 validation or learning ownership.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if a future domain change creates overlap with BP.12.
nodes.notes_limitations: This node replaces the 'BP.12 Uncertainty Routing Review' pattern used elsewhere, since BP.12 cannot route to itself.

nodes.purpose: Record the controller's explicit decision on whether the BP.12 branch is accepted as candidate, sent back for revision, or held.
nodes.required_output: Controller decision record: decision x rationale x date x conditions.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.6.1-BP.12.6.7; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: an explicit, dated controller decision exists; evidence_rationale: this is a governance decision, not evidence; cannot_support: any business claim.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: pending first controller review.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be inferred or defaulted; requires an explicit controller action.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any audited item changes after the decision is recorded.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.

nodes.purpose: Final gate confirming the BP.12 branch as a whole is ready to operate as the system of record for cross-domain risk and uncertainty.
nodes.required_output: BP.12 branch acceptance record.
nodes.evidence_requirement: source_family_required: BP.12.6.1-BP.12.6.8; evidence_tier_required: E1; sufficiency_threshold: controller decision recorded as accepted with no open critical-tier gaps; evidence_rationale: final structural and operational gate; cannot_support: that any individual business risk is resolved.
nodes.evidence_gaps_assumptions: Gap: pending BP.12.6.8 controller decision.
nodes.prohibited_claims_inference_patterns: Must not be self-assigned accepted.
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if the branch is later found incomplete or a domain surfaces a new BP.12-candidate item.
nodes.notes_limitations: None.
